manual:158491ccbdf08c51113b.source: If a download is interrupted or fails verification, the app makes up to three attempts. Each attempt starts again and must pass the same size and checksum checks. If it still fails, the error distinguishes an incomplete download from a checksum mismatch. Check your connection and try again. If it continues, include that error when reporting the problem.
manual:158491ccbdf08c51113b.text: ダウンロードが中断されたり検証に失敗したりすると、アプリは最大3回試みます。各回は最初からやり直し、同じサイズとチェックサムの確認に合格する必要があります。それでも失敗した場合、エラーはダウンロードが不完全なのかチェックサムが一致しないのかを区別して示します。接続を確認してもう一度お試しください。続く場合は、問題を報告するときにそのエラーを添えてください。

manual:128e0d464559fce231fb.source: In OverCue Desktop's Settings, choose the 44.1 kHz FLAC stems option. The XZ plays at 44.1 kHz, so it copies these stems straight into memory. A track's stems are ready sooner, the player does less work while it plays, and the stems take less space on the USB.
manual:128e0d464559fce231fb.text: OverCue Desktop の設定で、44.1 kHz FLAC のステムのオプションを選んでください。XZ は 44.1 kHz で再生するため、これらのステムをそのままメモリにコピーします。トラックのステムの準備が早く終わり、再生中のプレーヤーの処理が少なくなり、USB 上のステムの容量も小さくなります。

manual:3e0dc792b8c0b7aaefe2.source: OverCue's default is 96 kHz. These stems still play, but the XZ has to convert them while it plays. That takes about a third of one processor core per deck, and they take longer to become ready. With four decks playing, they become ready more slowly than the track plays.
manual:3e0dc792b8c0b7aaefe2.text: OverCue の初期設定は 96 kHz です。このステムも再生できますが、XZ が再生中に変換する必要があります。この変換には、デッキ1台あたりプロセッサーコア1個の約3分の1の処理能力が必要で、ステムの準備にも時間がかかります。4デッキで再生すると、ステムの準備がトラックの再生に追いつかなくなります。

manual:1ae5debbd341fb1d9a70.source: XZ Mods is software for the XDJ-XZ that starts from a USB stick. It adds a MODS menu, stems you can mute live, custom beat jump, four decks over a loopback cable, DJ profiles, themes and games. It can also replace the whole play screen with its own MODERN interface.
manual:1ae5debbd341fb1d9a70.text: XZ Mods は、USB メモリーから起動する XDJ-XZ 用のソフトウェアです。MODS メニュー、ライブでミュートできるステム、カスタムビートジャンプ、ループバックケーブルによる4デッキ、DJ プロフィール、テーマ、ゲームを追加します。プレイ画面全体を独自の MODERN インターフェイスに置き換えることもできます。

desktop:d5db97f97fc727f8fe10.source: SYNC 1 to SYNC 4: SYNC is on and follows that deck. BPM 1 to BPM 4: only the tempo follows, because QUANTIZE is off, a track has no beat grid, a loop is running, or the beat position is not available. LIMIT: the master tempo is out of reach, so the deck keeps its last tempo. EXT MASTER: a LINK player is master, which decks 3 and 4 cannot follow. NO BPM: analyse the track in your DJ software.
desktop:d5db97f97fc727f8fe10.text: SYNC 1 から SYNC 4: SYNC がオンにあり、そのデッキに従う。 BPM 1 から BPM 4: 単にペースが続きます、 QUANTIZE が消え、トラックがビットグリッドがない、ロープが動いている、またはビットポジションが利用できません。 LIMIT: マスターペースは、到達の外にあるので、デッキは最後のペースを保持します。 EXT MASTER: LINK プレーヤーはマスターであり、デッキ 3 と 4 が従うことができません。 NO BPM: DJ ソフトウェアでトラックを分析します。

manual:086e326b6e5d41258b81.source: PREV , NEXT > Step through the profiles on both USBs. 2 OF 3 shows where you are EDIT Change this profile's name, logo or tagline MAKE ACTIVE Makes this the active profile on its USB. Only the USB is written NEW PROFILE Makes another profile on the USB, for an alias or a back to back set CHECK USB Reads both USB ports again ACTIVE ON THIS USB This profile is the one its USB says is playing SHOWN TO THE VJ NOW This is the profile VJ software sees right now FROM ITS FOLDER IN DJPROFILE A profile made from a folder and a logo OLDER CARD: EDIT IT IN VJ.TOOLS An older profile card. Edit it in VJ.Tools, or make a new profile Your active profile also sits in the MODS header, with its logo and name. Tap it, or highlight it and push, to switch between the profiles on both USBs. Note The player's own saved settings are MY SETTINGS in UTILITY. They are separate from your DJ profile.
manual:086e326b6e5d41258b81.text: PREV , NEXT > 両方のUSBsのプロフィールを通じて進みます。2 OF 3 表示 EDIT このプロフィールの名前、ロゴまたはタグラインを変更する MAKE ACTIVE プロフィール USB でアクティブなプロフィールを作成します。USBだけが書かれています NEW PROFILE 他のプロフィールを作成します USB アリヤまたはバックセット CHECK USB 両方の USB ポートを再び読みます ACTIVE ON THIS USB このプロフィールはその USB が演奏していると言います SHOWN TO THE VJ NOW これはプロフィール VJ ソフトウェアが現在見る FROM ITS FOLDER IN DJPROFILE フォルダーとロゴから作成されたプロフィール OLDER CARD: EDIT IT IN VJ.TOOLS 古いプロフィールカードです。VJ.Toolsで編集するか、新しいプロフィールを作成するあなたのアクティブプロフィールは、ロゴと名前を含むMODSヘッダーにあります。それをタップするか、それを高めて押すので、両方のUSBsのプロフィールの間を切り替える。注記 プレイヤー自身の保存された設定は MY SETTINGS で UTILITY です。彼らは、あなたのDJプロフィールから離れています。

manual:20c2c0d610472848b864.source: PREV Tap MAKE ACTIVE Open CONNECT › DJ PROFILE . Push CREATE ON THIS XZ , or NEW PROFILE if the USB already has one. Type your DJ name on the on-screen keyboard, then push NEXT: LOGO . Pick a PNG or JPEG image from the USB, or NO LOGO . Images in your own DJPROFILE folder are listed first. Then push NEXT: TAGLINE . Type a few words, such as your genre, city or crew, and push NEXT: REVIEW . To leave the tagline out, push SKIP TAGLINE . Check the review, then push SAVE TO USB 1 or SAVE TO USB 2 . A new profile becomes the active profile on the USB you save it to. Only the DJPROFILE folder on that USB is written. Your music, playlists and stems are not touched. Step Controls Name and tagline The keyboard, SHIFT for capitals, #+= for symbols ( ABC goes back), SPACE , DELETE , BACK to the step before Logo One row per image on the USB, PREV and NEXT for more, RESCAN (or CHECK USB AGAIN ), NO LOGO , KEEP CURRENT when you edit Review CHANGE NAME , CHANGE LOGO , CHANGE TAGLINE , then SAVE TO USB 1 or SAVE TO USB 2 A name holds up to 64 characters and a tagline up to 80. With NO LOGO , your initial is shown on the accent colour. Logos are shown square over black. Nothing is saved until you push SAVE. The bottom line says NOTHING IS SAVED UNTIL YOU PRESS SAVE on the review step.
manual:20c2c0d610472848b864.text: PREV MAKE ACTIVE をタップ CONNECT › DJ PROFILE を開く 。CREATE ON THIS XZ を押すか、USB にすでにプロフィールがある場合は NEW PROFILE を押します。画面のキーボードで DJ 名を入力し、NEXT: LOGO を押します 。USB から PNG または JPEG の画像を選ぶか、NO LOGO を選びます 。自分の DJPROFILE フォルダーの画像が先に表示されます。次に NEXT: TAGLINE を押します 。ジャンル、街、クルーなどの短い言葉を入力し、NEXT: REVIEW を押します 。タグラインを付けない場合は SKIP TAGLINE を押します 。確認画面をチェックし、SAVE TO USB 1 または SAVE TO USB 2 を押します 。新しいプロフィールは、保存した USB でアクティブなプロフィールになります。書き込まれるのはその USB の DJPROFILE フォルダーだけです。音楽、プレイリスト、ステムには触れません。ステップ 操作 名前とタグライン キーボード、大文字は SHIFT 、記号は #+= （ ABC で戻る）、SPACE 、DELETE 、前のステップへは BACK ロゴ USB の画像ごとに1行、PREV と NEXT で続き、RESCAN （または CHECK USB AGAIN ）、NO LOGO 、編集時は KEEP CURRENT 確認 CHANGE NAME 、CHANGE LOGO 、CHANGE TAGLINE 、それから SAVE TO USB 1 または SAVE TO USB 2 名前は64文字まで、タグラインは80文字までです。NO LOGO では頭文字がアクセントカラーの上に表示されます。ロゴは黒の上に正方形で表示されます。SAVE を押すまで何も保存されません。確認ステップでは、最下行に NOTHING IS SAVED UNTIL YOU PRESS SAVE と表示されます。

manual:2392017bed94268c937d.source: When you pause the master, MASTER passes at once to the next playing deck. A deck with SYNC on comes first. Otherwise after deck 3 comes deck 4, then decks 1 and 2. After deck 4 come decks 1 and 2, then deck 3. In VINYL mode MASTER passes when you press pause, while the deck slows down.
manual:2392017bed94268c937d.text: マスターを一時停止すると、MASTER はすぐに次の再生中のデッキに移ります。SYNC がオンのデッキが優先です。それ以外では、デッキ3の次はデッキ4、次にデッキ1と2です。デッキ4の次はデッキ1と2、次にデッキ3です。VINYL モードでは、一時停止を押してデッキが減速している間に MASTER が移ります。

manual:309bd86e6dfe608aa6a6.source: In the pad mode you choose for stems, four pads switch stems on that deck. A, B and C mute the three stems in your STEM ORDER. D is BYPASS: it plays the original track instead of the stems. On a 4-stem track, D mutes bass instead. With the E-H bank, E to H do the same.
manual:309bd86e6dfe608aa6a6.text: パッドモードでは、あなたはステムを選択します、そのデッキで4つのパッドス ステムをスイッチします。A、BとCはあなたのSTEM ORDERでステムを3つ変えます。DはBYPASSです、ステムではなくオリジナルトレックをプレイします。 4-ステムのトラックでは、Dはバスを変えます。E-Hの銀行で、EからHと同じことをします。

manual:44747ca2968b85ca6fd6.source: Four decks adds two software players, DECK 3 and DECK 4, to the XDJ-XZ's own DECK 1 and DECK 2. You hear them on mixer channels CH3 and CH4. A short USB cable from the back of the player to a top USB port carries their sound into the mixer: it leaves through a top USB port and comes back in at the rear USB socket, where a computer with DJ software would connect. The physical controls switch between decks with the same presses DJ software uses on the XDJ-XZ.
manual:44747ca2968b85ca6fd6.text: 4つのデッキは、DECK 3とDECK 4のソフトウェアプレイヤーをXDJ-XZのDECK 1とDECK 2に追加しています。ミクサーチャンネルCH3とCH4で聴くことができます。プレイヤーの後ろからトップUSBポートまでの短いUSBケーブルはミクサーに音を運ぶ:それはトップUSBポートを通過し、後ろ USBソケットに戻り、DJソフトウェアを持つコンピュータが接続する。同様のプレッシャーで使用しているデッキ間の物理的なコントロールは、DJソフトウェアがXDJ-XZで使用している。

manual:4925f473ece7eec20df8.source: The bottom channels always follow the mixer, left to right: CH3, CH1, CH2, CH4. Mixer order puts the lanes in the same order, top to bottom. Each lane and each channel carries its deck's number in a badge, so you can always tell which deck is which. Decks 1 and 2 have a white number on grey. Decks 3 and 4 have a black number on white, as on the jog displays.
manual:4925f473ece7eec20df8.text: 下のチャンネルは常にミクサーを続ける、左に: CH3, CH1, CH2, CH4.ミクサー順序は、同じ順序で、上に下にランスを置きます。各ラインと各チャンネルがバージにそのデッキの番号を持ち、いつでもどのデッキであるかを伝えることができます。デッキ 1と2は灰色の白番号を持っています。デッキ 3と4はヨーグディスプレイのよう、白の黒番号を持っています.

manual:5cced1da3c9c850e24cc.source: on the top bar. Open it to see deck 3 and 4 audio render times and active key shifters across all four decks. P99 is the time at or below which 99% of the last 256 rendered blocks finished; MAX is the longest. Short blocks are scaled to a full block. D3+D4 MAX adds both maxima and compares them with the 5,805 microseconds available per block. New shifts use a stricter 3,483 microsecond budget, leaving time for other work. These render numbers include decoding, time stretch and key shift; they do not measure the complete output path. Use them when you suspect the player is working hard, for example with stems on both decks and four decks running.
manual:5cced1da3c9c850e24cc.text: トップバーで. デッキ3と4のオーディオレンダ時間と4のデッキ全体でアクティブキーシフトを見るためにそれを開く。 P99 は、最後の 256 レンダードブロックの99%が完了した時間、 MAX が長い。 ショートブロックは完全なブロックにスケールされます。 D3+D4 MAX は、最大両方を追加し、ブロック当たり 5,805 ミクロ秒と比較します。 新しい変動は、厳格な予算を使用し、他の作業に時間を残します。 これらのレンダ 数はデコード、タイムストレッチ、キーシフトを含む。 彼らは完全の出力路を測定しない。 プレイヤーが苦労していることを疑うとき、例えば、デッキと4デッキで ステム で動く

manual:62a43847aca915aa72a9.source: Turn the side while the deck plays to bend its speed. The faster you turn, the more it bends, so a gentle nudge moves it only a little. With VINYL on, scratch on the platter top. For a backspin, spin the platter and let go: the deck follows the platter until it stops, then plays on.
manual:62a43847aca915aa72a9.text: デッキが速度を振り回す間に側を回す。あなたが回るほど速く、より速く振り回るほど、柔らかいナッジがそれを少しだけ動かします。VINYLで、板の上にスクリッチします。バックスピンには、板を振り向いて行けます:デッキは、そのまま止まるまで板を追いかけ、その後再びプレーします。

manual:66f696237305f7717178.source: The large key in each deck's column is the key the deck plays right now. Tempo with MASTER TEMPO off, a key shift and KEY SYNC all move it. Its colour compares it with the master deck's key. Green means it mixes with the master's key: the same key, its relative major or minor, or one step away on the key wheel, tuned within 25 cents of the master. Amber means it would mix, but it is detuned by more than 25 cents. White means neither, and the master deck itself is always white. Turn KEY MATCH COLOURS off in
manual:66f696237305f7717178.text: デッキの各コラムの大きな鍵は、デッキが今プレイする鍵です。 MASTER TEMPO オフ、キーシフトとKEY SYNC すべて移動します。その色はマスターデッキの鍵と比較します。緑はマスターの鍵と混合します:同じキー、その相対の主要または小さい、またはマスターの25セント以内にトゥーンのキーの1歩離れたキーの1つのステップです。アンバーは混合することを意味しますが、それは25セント以上で分断されます。ホワイトは意味ではありませんし、マスターデッキ自体は常に白です。 KEY MATCH COLOURS オフ

manual:e6cccc4ccf08f26a2838.source: Four channels in mixer order 3 1 2 4. Each shows the deck's title, time, QUANTIZE, tempo and range, AUTO CUE and MT, what SYNC follows, what the pads do, the BPM (orange with MASTER for the master deck) and the whole-track overview. A deck that is not connected shows a dim band with NOT CONNECTED and DECK n WAITS FOR THE LOOPBACK CABLE.
manual:e6cccc4ccf08f26a2838.text: ミキサー順 3 1 2 4 の4チャンネル。それぞれにデッキのタイトル、時間、QUANTIZE、テンポと範囲、AUTO CUE と MT、SYNC の追従先、パッドの働き、BPM（マスターデッキはオレンジで MASTER 付き）、トラック全体の概観が表示されます。接続されていないデッキには NOT CONNECTED と DECK n WAITS FOR THE LOOPBACK CABLE の暗い帯が表示されます。

manual:dcc7cfcae27bf623ed16.source: While the player records, the diary writes nothing to the stick in USB 2, where the recording goes. Each stick holds at most 4 MiB of diary files. Older segments are replaced first, and the previous session's latest segment is kept when a new session starts. Writing pauses during track loads, RAM copies and heavy USB reads. No diary is created on a read-only stick or when less than 64 MiB of free space plus a small write reserve remains. Read-only test sessions save nothing. Normal USB-loader sessions write diary entries when these conditions allow it. Long busy periods and removal can leave gaps.
manual:dcc7cfcae27bf623ed16.text: プレーヤーが録音している間、記録は録音先である USB 2 の スティックに何も書き込みません。各スチックは、日記ファイルの最大4 MiBを保持します。古いセグメントは最初に置き換え、新しいセッションが開始するときに、前のセクションの最新セグメントが保存されます。 トレックロード、RAMコピーと重いUSB読書の間の書き方休憩。 読書単独のスチックまたは64 MiBの自由スペースが少なくない場合に日記を作成されません。 読み単独テストセッションは何も保存しない。 通常の USB ロイダーセッションはこれらの条件が許可するときに日記の入力を書きます。 長い忙しい期間と削除は、間隔を残すことができます。

manual:128e0d464559fce231fb.source: In OverCue Desktop's Settings, choose the 44.1 kHz FLAC stems option. The XZ plays at 44.1 kHz, so it copies these stems straight into memory. A track's stems are ready sooner, the player does less work while it plays, and the stems take less space on the USB.
manual:128e0d464559fce231fb.text: OverCue Desktop의 설정에서 44.1 kHz FLAC 스템 옵션을 선택하세요. XZ는 44.1 kHz로 재생하므로 이 스템을 그대로 메모리에 복사합니다. 트랙의 스템이 더 빨리 준비되고, 플레이어의 재생 중 작업량이 줄어들며, USB에서 스템이 차지하는 공간도 줄어듭니다.

provenance.author: Claude Opus 5.5, not reviewed by a native speaker
provenance.reason: Authored for the OverCue Desktop 44.1 kHz FLAC stems guidance (0.5.1-Beta.3). Replaces Small100 output that changed the meaning, garbled headings or used the wrong word for stems. Native-speaker review remains open.

manual:3e0dc792b8c0b7aaefe2.source: OverCue's default is 96 kHz. These stems still play, but the XZ has to convert them while it plays. That takes about a third of one processor core per deck, and they take longer to become ready. With four decks playing, they become ready more slowly than the track plays.
manual:3e0dc792b8c0b7aaefe2.text: OverCue의 기본값은 96 kHz입니다. 이 스템도 재생되지만, XZ가 재생하는 동안 변환해야 합니다. 이 변환에는 덱 하나당 프로세서 코어 하나의 약 3분의 1이 필요하고, 스템이 준비되는 데에도 더 오래 걸립니다. 네 덱이 재생 중이면 스템 준비가 트랙 재생 속도를 따라가지 못합니다.

manual:086e326b6e5d41258b81.source: PREV , NEXT > Step through the profiles on both USBs. 2 OF 3 shows where you are EDIT Change this profile's name, logo or tagline MAKE ACTIVE Makes this the active profile on its USB. Only the USB is written NEW PROFILE Makes another profile on the USB, for an alias or a back to back set CHECK USB Reads both USB ports again ACTIVE ON THIS USB This profile is the one its USB says is playing SHOWN TO THE VJ NOW This is the profile VJ software sees right now FROM ITS FOLDER IN DJPROFILE A profile made from a folder and a logo OLDER CARD: EDIT IT IN VJ.TOOLS An older profile card. Edit it in VJ.Tools, or make a new profile Your active profile also sits in the MODS header, with its logo and name. Tap it, or highlight it and push, to switch between the profiles on both USBs. Note The player's own saved settings are MY SETTINGS in UTILITY. They are separate from your DJ profile.
manual:086e326b6e5d41258b81.text: PREV , NEXT > 두 개의 프로필을 통해 Step USBs. 2 OF 3 당신이있는 곳 EDIT 이 프로필의 이름, 로고 또는 태그 라인 MAKE ACTIVE 그것의 USB에 활성 프로필을 만듭니다. USB만 작성된 NEW PROFILE USB에 다른 프로필을 만든다, 알리미나 뒤쪽 세트를 위해 CHECK USB 다시 USB 포트를 읽습니다 ACTIVE ON THIS USB 이 프로필은 USB은 재생하는 것이라고 말합니다 SHOWN TO THE VJ NOW 이것은 프로필 VJ 소프트웨어는 현재 FROM ITS FOLDER IN DJPROFILE 폴더와 로고 OLDER CARD: EDIT IT IN VJ.TOOLS 오래된 프로필 카드에서 만든 프로필입니다. VJ.Tools에 편집하거나 새 프로필을 만들기 귀하의 활성 프로파일도 MODS 헤더에 앉아 있습니다, 로고와 이름. 그것을 터치하거나 강조하고, 프로파일 사이에 스위치하려면, USBs의 프로파일에 전환 할 수 있습니다. 참고 플레이어 자신의 저장 설정은 MY SETTINGS에서 UTILITY입니다. 그들은 DJ 프로파일과 분리됩니다.

manual:20c2c0d610472848b864.source: PREV Tap MAKE ACTIVE Open CONNECT › DJ PROFILE . Push CREATE ON THIS XZ , or NEW PROFILE if the USB already has one. Type your DJ name on the on-screen keyboard, then push NEXT: LOGO . Pick a PNG or JPEG image from the USB, or NO LOGO . Images in your own DJPROFILE folder are listed first. Then push NEXT: TAGLINE . Type a few words, such as your genre, city or crew, and push NEXT: REVIEW . To leave the tagline out, push SKIP TAGLINE . Check the review, then push SAVE TO USB 1 or SAVE TO USB 2 . A new profile becomes the active profile on the USB you save it to. Only the DJPROFILE folder on that USB is written. Your music, playlists and stems are not touched. Step Controls Name and tagline The keyboard, SHIFT for capitals, #+= for symbols ( ABC goes back), SPACE , DELETE , BACK to the step before Logo One row per image on the USB, PREV and NEXT for more, RESCAN (or CHECK USB AGAIN ), NO LOGO , KEEP CURRENT when you edit Review CHANGE NAME , CHANGE LOGO , CHANGE TAGLINE , then SAVE TO USB 1 or SAVE TO USB 2 A name holds up to 64 characters and a tagline up to 80. With NO LOGO , your initial is shown on the accent colour. Logos are shown square over black. Nothing is saved until you push SAVE. The bottom line says NOTHING IS SAVED UNTIL YOU PRESS SAVE on the review step.
manual:20c2c0d610472848b864.text: PREV 탭 MAKE ACTIVE 오픈 CONNECT › DJ PROFILE . CREATE ON THIS XZ 또는 USB가 이미 하나를 가지고 있다면 NEW PROFILE을 눌러십시오. 스크린 키보드에 DJ 이름을 입력하고, NEXT: LOGO을 누르십시오. USB 또는 NO LOGO에서 PNG 또는 JPEG 이미지를 선택합니다. 자신의 DJPROFILE 폴더에있는 이미지가 먼저 목록됩니다. 다음은 NEXT: TAGLINE을 누르십시오. 당신의 장르, 도시 또는 승무원과 같은 몇 가지 단어를 입력하고 NEXT: REVIEW을 누르십시오. 태그 라인을 떠나려면 SKIP TAGLINE를 누르십시오. 검토를 확인하고 SAVE TO USB 1 또는 SAVE TO USB 2를 누르십시오. 새 프로필은 당신이 저장하는 USB에 활성 프로필이됩니다. 이 폴더의 DJPROFILE 폴더가 USB에 쓰여져 있습니다. 귀하의 음악, 재생 목록 및 스템은 터치되지 않습니다. 단계 컨트롤 이름 및 태그 라인 키보드, 자본을위한 SHIFT, #+= ( ABC 돌아갑니다), SPACE , DELETE , BACK 이상의 USB, PREV 및 NEXT의 이미지에 로고 1 줄, RESCAN (또는 CHECK USB AGAIN ), NO LOGO , KEEP CURRENT 당신이 편집 할 때 검토 CHANGE NAME , CHANGE LOGO , CHANGE TAGLINE , SAVE TO USB 1 또는 SAVE TO USB 2 이름은 최대 64 문자와 80까지 태그 라인을 유지합니다. NO LOGO와 함께, 당신의 원본은 액센트 색상에 표시됩니다. 로고는 검은색 위의 사각형으로 표시됩니다. SAVE을 눌러 때까지 아무것도 저장되지 않습니다. 아래 줄은 검토 단계에 대한 NOTHING IS SAVED UNTIL YOU PRESS SAVE를 말합니다.

manual:309bd86e6dfe608aa6a6.source: In the pad mode you choose for stems, four pads switch stems on that deck. A, B and C mute the three stems in your STEM ORDER. D is BYPASS: it plays the original track instead of the stems. On a 4-stem track, D mutes bass instead. With the E-H bank, E to H do the same.
manual:309bd86e6dfe608aa6a6.text: 스템용으로 고른 패드 모드에서는 패드 네 개가 그 덱의 스템을 전환합니다. A, B, C는 STEM ORDER 순서대로 세 스템을 뮤트합니다. D는 BYPASS로, 스템 대신 원래 트랙을 재생합니다. 4스템 트랙에서는 D가 대신 베이스를 뮤트합니다. E-H 뱅크에서는 E~H가 같은 일을 합니다.

manual:44747ca2968b85ca6fd6.source: Four decks adds two software players, DECK 3 and DECK 4, to the XDJ-XZ's own DECK 1 and DECK 2. You hear them on mixer channels CH3 and CH4. A short USB cable from the back of the player to a top USB port carries their sound into the mixer: it leaves through a top USB port and comes back in at the rear USB socket, where a computer with DJ software would connect. The physical controls switch between decks with the same presses DJ software uses on the XDJ-XZ.
manual:44747ca2968b85ca6fd6.text: 4덱은 XDJ-XZ 자체의 DECK 1과 DECK 2에 소프트웨어 플레이어 두 개, DECK 3과 DECK 4를 더합니다. 소리는 믹서 채널 CH3과 CH4에서 들립니다. 플레이어 뒷면에서 윗면 USB 포트로 연결하는 짧은 USB 케이블이 그 소리를 믹서로 보냅니다. 소리는 윗면 USB 포트로 나가서, DJ 소프트웨어가 설치된 컴퓨터를 연결하는 뒷면 USB 소켓으로 다시 들어옵니다. 실제 컨트롤은 DJ 소프트웨어가 XDJ-XZ에서 쓰는 것과 같은 누름 조작으로 덱을 전환합니다.

manual:66f696237305f7717178.source: The large key in each deck's column is the key the deck plays right now. Tempo with MASTER TEMPO off, a key shift and KEY SYNC all move it. Its colour compares it with the master deck's key. Green means it mixes with the master's key: the same key, its relative major or minor, or one step away on the key wheel, tuned within 25 cents of the master. Amber means it would mix, but it is detuned by more than 25 cents. White means neither, and the master deck itself is always white. Turn KEY MATCH COLOURS off in
manual:66f696237305f7717178.text: 덱의 각 열의 큰 키는 덱가 지금 플레이하는 키입니다. MASTER TEMPO 끄고, 키 Shift 및 KEY SYNC 모두 이동합니다. 그 색깔은 마스터 덱의 키와 비교합니다. 그 녹색은 마스터 키와 혼합합니다: 같은 키, 상대적인 주요 또는 작은, 또는 마스터의 25 센트 내에 묶여 키 휠에서 한 걸음 떨어져 있습니다. 암버는 혼합 할 것, 그러나 25 센티 이상의 분해됩니다. 흰색은 의미하지 않습니다, 마스터 덱 자체는 항상 흰색입니다. manual:973a24f64673d04048db.source: RAM TRACKS copies the track on a deck into the player's memory. The deck then plays from memory, so it keeps playing if the music USB goes out. It works on all four decks. Decks 3 and 4 need the loopback cable connected to start a copy.

Each shows the deck's title, time, QUANTIZE, tempo and range, AUTO CUE and MT, what SYNC follows, what the pads do, the BPM (orange with MASTER for the master deck) and the whole-track overview. manual:dcc7cfcae27bf623ed16.source: While the player records, the diary writes nothing to the stick in USB 2, where the recording goes. Each stick holds at most 4 MiB of diary files. Older segments are replaced first, and the previous session's latest segment is kept when a new session starts. Writing pauses during track loads, RAM copies and heavy USB reads. No diary is created on a read-only stick or when less than 64 MiB of free space plus a small write reserve remains. Read-only test sessions save nothing. Normal USB-loader sessions write diary entries when these conditions allow it. Long busy periods and removal can leave gaps.
manual:dcc7cfcae27bf623ed16.text: 플레이어가 녹음하는 동안 기록은 녹음이 저장되는 USB 2의 스틱에 아무것도 쓰지 않습니다. 각 스틱은 최대 4 MiB의 일기 파일을 보유합니다. 오래된 세그먼트는 먼저 교체되고 이전 세션의 최신 세그먼지는 새 세션이 시작되면 유지됩니다. 트랙로드, RAM 복사 및 무거운 USB 읽기 동안 작성 중단됩니다. 읽기만 할 수있는 스틱 또는 64 MiB의 자유 공간이 적은 경우 일기 창조되지 않습니다. 읽기 만 테스트 세션은 아무것도 저장하지 않습니다. 일반 USB 로더 세션은 이러한 조건이 허용 할 때 일기 항목을 작성합니다. 긴 바쁜 기간 및 제거는 격차를 남겨두고 있습니다.

manual:158491ccbdf08c51113b.source: If a download is interrupted or fails verification, the app makes up to three attempts. Each attempt starts again and must pass the same size and checksum checks. If it still fails, the error distinguishes an incomplete download from a checksum mismatch. Check your connection and try again. If it continues, include that error when reporting the problem.
manual:158491ccbdf08c51113b.text: Si una descarga se interrumpe o no pasa la verificación, la aplicación lo intenta hasta tres veces. Cada intento empieza de nuevo y debe pasar las mismas comprobaciones de tamaño y suma de verificación. Si aun así falla, el error distingue una descarga incompleta de una suma de verificación que no coincide. Compruebe su conexión e inténtelo de nuevo. Si sigue ocurriendo, incluya ese error al informar del problema.

manual:128e0d464559fce231fb.source: In OverCue Desktop's Settings, choose the 44.1 kHz FLAC stems option. The XZ plays at 44.1 kHz, so it copies these stems straight into memory. A track's stems are ready sooner, the player does less work while it plays, and the stems take less space on the USB.

Los stems de una pista están listos antes, el reproductor trabaja menos mientras reproduce y los stems ocupan menos espacio en el USB.

manual:3e0dc792b8c0b7aaefe2.source: OverCue's default is 96 kHz. These stems still play, but the XZ has to convert them while it plays. That takes about a third of one processor core per deck, and they take longer to become ready. With four decks playing, they become ready more slowly than the track plays.
manual:3e0dc792b8c0b7aaefe2.text: El valor predeterminado de OverCue es 96 kHz. Estos stems se reproducen igualmente, pero el XZ tiene que convertirlos mientras reproduce. Eso consume alrededor de un tercio de un núcleo del procesador por deck, y los stems tardan más en estar listos. Con cuatro decks en reproducción, se preparan más despacio de lo que avanza la pista.

manual:20c2c0d610472848b864.source: PREV Tap MAKE ACTIVE Open CONNECT › DJ PROFILE . Push CREATE ON THIS XZ , or NEW PROFILE if the USB already has one. Type your DJ name on the on-screen keyboard, then push NEXT: LOGO . Pick a PNG or JPEG image from the USB, or NO LOGO . Images in your own DJPROFILE folder are listed first. Then push NEXT: TAGLINE . Type a few words, such as your genre, city or crew, and push NEXT: REVIEW . To leave the tagline out, push SKIP TAGLINE . Check the review, then push SAVE TO USB 1 or SAVE TO USB 2 . A new profile becomes the active profile on the USB you save it to. Only the DJPROFILE folder on that USB is written. Your music, playlists and stems are not touched. Step Controls Name and tagline The keyboard, SHIFT for capitals, #+= for symbols ( ABC goes back), SPACE , DELETE , BACK to the step before Logo One row per image on the USB, PREV and NEXT for more, RESCAN (or CHECK USB AGAIN ), NO LOGO , KEEP CURRENT when you edit Review CHANGE NAME , CHANGE LOGO , CHANGE TAGLINE , then SAVE TO USB 1 or SAVE TO USB 2 A name holds up to 64 characters and a tagline up to 80. With NO LOGO , your initial is shown on the accent colour. Logos are shown square over black. Nothing is saved until you push SAVE. The bottom line says NOTHING IS SAVED UNTIL YOU PRESS SAVE on the review step.
manual:20c2c0d610472848b864.text: PREV Tap MAKE ACTIVE Open CONNECT › DJ PROFILE . Push CREATE ON THIS XZ, o NEW PROFILE si el USB ya tiene uno. Introduce tu nombre de DJ en el teclado en la pantalla, luego presione NEXT: LOGO. Seleccione una imagen PNG o JPEG de la USB, o NO LOGO. Las imágenes en su propia carpeta DJPROFILE se listan primero. Después empujar el NEXT: TAGLINE . Escriba algunas palabras, como su género, ciudad o tripulación, y presiona NEXT: REVIEW. Para dejar la etiqueta, presione SKIP TAGLINE . Verifique la revisión y luego presione SAVE TO USB 1 o SAVE TO USB 2. Un nuevo perfil se convierte en el perfil activo en el USB al que lo guardas. Sólo se escribe la carpeta DJPROFILE en ese USB. Su música, listas de reproducción y stems no están tocados. Controles de pasos Nombre y etiqueta El teclado, SHIFT para los capitales, #+= para los símbolos (ABC vuelve), SPACE , DELETE , BACK al paso antes del logotipo Una fila por imagen en el USB, PREV y NEXT para más, RESCAN (o CHECK USB AGAIN ), NO LOGO , KEEP CURRENT cuando edita Revisión CHANGE NAME, CHANGE LOGO , CHANGE TAGLINE , luego SAVE TO USB 1 o SAVE TO USB 2 Un nombre tiene hasta 64 caracteres y una etiqueta hasta 80. Con NO LOGO, su original se muestra en el color de acento. Los logotipos se muestran cuadrados sobre negro. Nada se salva hasta que empurra SAVE. La línea inferior dice NOTHING IS SAVED UNTIL YOU PRESS SAVE en el paso de revisión.

manual:5cced1da3c9c850e24cc.source: on the top bar. Open it to see deck 3 and 4 audio render times and active key shifters across all four decks. P99 is the time at or below which 99% of the last 256 rendered blocks finished; MAX is the longest. Short blocks are scaled to a full block. D3+D4 MAX adds both maxima and compares them with the 5,805 microseconds available per block. New shifts use a stricter 3,483 microsecond budget, leaving time for other work. These render numbers include decoding, time stretch and key shift; they do not measure the complete output path. Use them when you suspect the player is working hard, for example with stems on both decks and four decks running.
manual:5cced1da3c9c850e24cc.text: en la barra superior. Abra para ver el horario de reproducción de audio deck 3 y 4 y los cambios de clave activos en todos los cuatro decks. P99 es el tiempo en el que el 99% de los últimos 256 bloques de reproducción terminaron; MAX es el más largo. Los bloques cortos se escalaban hasta un bloque completo. D3+D4 MAX añade ambos el máximo y las compara con los 5,805 microsecundos disponibles por bloque. Nuevos cambios usan un presupuesto más estricto de 3,483 microsecondos, dejando tiempo para otras obras. Estos números de reproducción incluyen decodificación, el estrito de tiempo y el cambio de clave; no medir el camino de salida completo. Utilizan cuando sospechas que el jugador está trabajando duro, por ejemplo con stems en ambos decks y cuatro decks en marcha.

desktop:d5db97f97fc727f8fe10.source: SYNC 1 to SYNC 4: SYNC is on and follows that deck. BPM 1 to BPM 4: only the tempo follows, because QUANTIZE is off, a track has no beat grid, a loop is running, or the beat position is not available. LIMIT: the master tempo is out of reach, so the deck keeps its last tempo. EXT MASTER: a LINK player is master, which decks 3 and 4 cannot follow. NO BPM: analyse the track in your DJ software.
desktop:d5db97f97fc727f8fe10.text: SYNC 1 a SYNC 4: SYNC está en marcha y sigue ese deck. BPM 1 a BPM 4: sólo el ritmo sigue, porque QUANTIZE está apagado, una pista no tiene grilla de golpe, un loop está en marcha o la posición de golpe no está disponible. LIMIT: el ritmo maestro está fuera de alcance, por lo que el deck mantiene su último ritmo. EXT MASTER: un jugador de LINK es maestro, que los decks 3 y 4 no pueden seguir. NO BPM: Analizar la pista en su software DJ.

manual:086e326b6e5d41258b81.source: PREV , NEXT > Step through the profiles on both USBs. 2 OF 3 shows where you are EDIT Change this profile's name, logo or tagline MAKE ACTIVE Makes this the active profile on its USB. Only the USB is written NEW PROFILE Makes another profile on the USB, for an alias or a back to back set CHECK USB Reads both USB ports again ACTIVE ON THIS USB This profile is the one its USB says is playing SHOWN TO THE VJ NOW This is the profile VJ software sees right now FROM ITS FOLDER IN DJPROFILE A profile made from a folder and a logo OLDER CARD: EDIT IT IN VJ.TOOLS An older profile card. Edit it in VJ.Tools, or make a new profile Your active profile also sits in the MODS header, with its logo and name. Tap it, or highlight it and push, to switch between the profiles on both USBs. Note The player's own saved settings are MY SETTINGS in UTILITY. They are separate from your DJ profile.
manual:086e326b6e5d41258b81.text: PREV , NEXT > Paso por los perfiles en ambos USBs. 2 OF 3 muestra donde eres EDIT Cambia el nombre de este perfil, logotipo o etiqueta MAKE ACTIVE hace esto el perfil activo en su USB. Sólo el USB está escrito NEW PROFILE hace otro perfil en el USB, para un alias o un set backward CHECK USB Lea ambos USB puertos de nuevo ACTIVE ON THIS USB Este perfil es el que su USB dice que está jugando SHOWN TO THE VJ NOW Este es el perfil VJ software ve ahora FROM ITS FOLDER IN DJPROFILE Un perfil hecho de una carpeta y un logotipo OLDER CARD: EDIT IT IN VJ.TOOLS Una tarjeta de perfil más antigua. Editarlo en VJ.Tools, o hacer un nuevo perfil Su perfil activo también se encuentra en el título MODS, con su logotipo y nombre. toque, o destacarlo y empujar, para cambiar entre los perfiles de ambos USBs. Nota La configuración guardada del jugador es MY SETTINGS en UTILITY. Se separan de su perfil DJ.

manual:2392017bed94268c937d.source: When you pause the master, MASTER passes at once to the next playing deck. A deck with SYNC on comes first. Otherwise after deck 3 comes deck 4, then decks 1 and 2. After deck 4 come decks 1 and 2, then deck 3. In VINYL mode MASTER passes when you press pause, while the deck slows down.
manual:2392017bed94268c937d.text: Cuando se detiene el maestro, MASTER pasa de inmediato al próximo deck jugador. Un deck con SYNC en viene primero. De lo contrario después del deck 3 llega el deck 4, luego los deck 1 y 2. Después del deck 4 vienen los deck 1 e 2, luego el deck 3. En el modo VINYL MASTER pasa cuando presiona la pausa, mientras el deck se desacelera.

manual:44747ca2968b85ca6fd6.source: Four decks adds two software players, DECK 3 and DECK 4, to the XDJ-XZ's own DECK 1 and DECK 2. You hear them on mixer channels CH3 and CH4. A short USB cable from the back of the player to a top USB port carries their sound into the mixer: it leaves through a top USB port and comes back in at the rear USB socket, where a computer with DJ software would connect. The physical controls switch between decks with the same presses DJ software uses on the XDJ-XZ.
manual:44747ca2968b85ca6fd6.text: Cuatro decks añaden dos jugadores de software, DECK 3 y DECK 4, a los propios DECK 1 y DECK 2 de XDJ-XZ. Se oye en los canales de mezcla CH3 y CH4. Un corto cable USB desde la parte posterior del jugador a un puerto superior USB lleva su sonido al mezcla: sale a través de un puerto de USB superior y vuelve a entrar en el soporte posterior USB, donde un ordenador con software de DJ se conectaría. Los controles físicos intervienen entre decks con los mismos programas que utiliza el software de DJ en el XDJ-XZ.

manual:4925f473ece7eec20df8.source: The bottom channels always follow the mixer, left to right: CH3, CH1, CH2, CH4. Mixer order puts the lanes in the same order, top to bottom. Each lane and each channel carries its deck's number in a badge, so you can always tell which deck is which. Decks 1 and 2 have a white number on grey. Decks 3 and 4 have a black number on white, as on the jog displays.
manual:4925f473ece7eec20df8.text: Los canales inferiores siempre siguen al mezclador, a la izquierda a la derecha: CH3, CH1, CH2, CH4. El orden del mezclador pone las líneas en el mismo orden, arriba a abajo. Cada pista y cada canal lleva su número de deck en una marca, por lo que siempre puede decir cuál es el deck. Los decks 1 y 2 tienen un número blanco en gris. Los decks 3 y 4 tienen un número negro en blanco, como en las pantallas de jog.

manual:66f696237305f7717178.source: The large key in each deck's column is the key the deck plays right now. Tempo with MASTER TEMPO off, a key shift and KEY SYNC all move it. Its colour compares it with the master deck's key. Green means it mixes with the master's key: the same key, its relative major or minor, or one step away on the key wheel, tuned within 25 cents of the master. Amber means it would mix, but it is detuned by more than 25 cents. White means neither, and the master deck itself is always white. Turn KEY MATCH COLOURS off in
manual:66f696237305f7717178.text: La clave grande en cada columna de deck es la clave que juega el deck en este momento. Tempo con MASTER TEMPO off, un cambio clave y KEY SYNC todos moverse. Su color lo compara con la clave del deck principal. Verde significa que se mezcla con la llave del maestro: la misma llave, su relativa mayor o menor, o un paso de distancia en la rueda clave, ajustado dentro de 25 céntimos del maestro. A missing measurement stays unknown.

Una medición falta permanece desconocida.

Los pasos debajo del vídeo se iluminan a medida que los alcanza. Haga clic en un paso para jugar desde allí. Cuando una sección muestra más de una manera, las pestañas por encima de los pasos se intervienen entre ellos.

manual:eabd4a87cc18b587a787.source: While decks 3 and 4 are not running, a four-deck view puts a card in their lanes. The card shows the cable steps, the state, and the buttons you need. Decks 1 and 2 stay live above it. In number order the card fills the lanes of decks 3 and 4 under decks 1 and 2. In mixer order it splits into a strip above deck 1 and a strip below deck 2.
manual:eabd4a87cc18b587a787.text: Si bien los decks 3 y 4 no funcionan, una vista de cuatro decks pone una tarjeta en sus senderos. La tarjeta muestra los pasos del cable, el estado y los botones que necesitas. Los decks 1 y 2 permanecen en vivo por encima de ella. En orden número la tarjeta rellen las senderos de decks 3 e 4 bajo los decks 1 e 2. En orden mixer se divide en una cinta por encima del deck 1 y una cinta por debajo del deck 2.

manual:dcc7cfcae27bf623ed16.source: While the player records, the diary writes nothing to the stick in USB 2, where the recording goes. Each stick holds at most 4 MiB of diary files. Older segments are replaced first, and the previous session's latest segment is kept when a new session starts. Writing pauses during track loads, RAM copies and heavy USB reads. No diary is created on a read-only stick or when less than 64 MiB of free space plus a small write reserve remains. Read-only test sessions save nothing. Normal USB-loader sessions write diary entries when these conditions allow it. Long busy periods and removal can leave gaps.
manual:dcc7cfcae27bf623ed16.text: Mientras el reproductor graba, el diario no escribe nada en el stick de USB 2, donde va la grabación. Cada stick tiene un máximo de 4 MiB de archivos de diario. Los segmentos antiguos se reemplazan primero, y el último segmento de la sesión anterior se mantiene cuando comience una nueva sesión. Las pausas de escritura durante las cargas de pista, RAM copias y USB lecturas pesadas. No se crea un diario en un stick solo de lectura o cuando se quedan menos de 64 MiB de espacio libre y una pequeña reserva de escritura. Las sesiones de prueba solo de lectura guardan nada. Las sesciones normales de carga USB escriben entradas de diario cuando estas condiciones lo permiten. Los largos períodos ocupados y la eliminación pueden dejar vacíos.

manual:158491ccbdf08c51113b.source: If a download is interrupted or fails verification, the app makes up to three attempts. Each attempt starts again and must pass the same size and checksum checks. If it still fails, the error distinguishes an incomplete download from a checksum mismatch. Check your connection and try again. If it continues, include that error when reporting the problem.
manual:158491ccbdf08c51113b.text: Si un téléchargement est interrompu ou échoue à la vérification, l'application fait jusqu'à trois tentatives. Chaque tentative recommence et doit passer les mêmes contrôles de taille et de somme de contrôle. Si cela échoue encore, l'erreur distingue un téléchargement incomplet d'une somme de contrôle qui ne correspond pas. Vérifiez votre connexion et réessayez. Si cela continue, joignez cette erreur en signalant le problème.

manual:128e0d464559fce231fb.source: In OverCue Desktop's Settings, choose the 44.1 kHz FLAC stems option. The XZ plays at 44.1 kHz, so it copies these stems straight into memory. A track's stems are ready sooner, the player does less work while it plays, and the stems take less space on the USB.
manual:128e0d464559fce231fb.text: Dans les Paramètres d'OverCue Desktop, choisissez l'option de stems FLAC en 44.1 kHz. La XZ lit l'audio en 44.1 kHz, elle copie donc ces stems directement en mémoire. Les stems d'une piste sont prêts plus tôt, le lecteur travaille moins pendant la lecture, et les stems prennent moins de place sur la clé USB.

provenance.author: Claude Opus 5.5, not reviewed by a native speaker

manual:3e0dc792b8c0b7aaefe2.source: OverCue's default is 96 kHz. These stems still play, but the XZ has to convert them while it plays. That takes about a third of one processor core per deck, and they take longer to become ready. With four decks playing, they become ready more slowly than the track plays.
manual:3e0dc792b8c0b7aaefe2.text: Le réglage par défaut d'OverCue est 96 kHz. Ces stems sont tout de même lus, mais la XZ doit les convertir pendant la lecture. Cela occupe environ un tiers d'un cœur de processeur par deck, et les stems mettent plus de temps à être prêts. Avec quatre decks en lecture, ils se préparent plus lentement que la piste ne défile.

manual:20c2c0d610472848b864.source: PREV Tap MAKE ACTIVE Open CONNECT › DJ PROFILE . Push CREATE ON THIS XZ , or NEW PROFILE if the USB already has one. Type your DJ name on the on-screen keyboard, then push NEXT: LOGO . Pick a PNG or JPEG image from the USB, or NO LOGO . Images in your own DJPROFILE folder are listed first. Then push NEXT: TAGLINE . Type a few words, such as your genre, city or crew, and push NEXT: REVIEW . To leave the tagline out, push SKIP TAGLINE . Check the review, then push SAVE TO USB 1 or SAVE TO USB 2 . A new profile becomes the active profile on the USB you save it to. Only the DJPROFILE folder on that USB is written. Your music, playlists and stems are not touched. Step Controls Name and tagline The keyboard, SHIFT for capitals, #+= for symbols ( ABC goes back), SPACE , DELETE , BACK to the step before Logo One row per image on the USB, PREV and NEXT for more, RESCAN (or CHECK USB AGAIN ), NO LOGO , KEEP CURRENT when you edit Review CHANGE NAME , CHANGE LOGO , CHANGE TAGLINE , then SAVE TO USB 1 or SAVE TO USB 2 A name holds up to 64 characters and a tagline up to 80. With NO LOGO , your initial is shown on the accent colour. Logos are shown square over black. Nothing is saved until you push SAVE. The bottom line says NOTHING IS SAVED UNTIL YOU PRESS SAVE on the review step.
manual:20c2c0d610472848b864.text: PREV Touchez MAKE ACTIVE Ouvrez CONNECT › DJ PROFILE . Appuyez sur CREATE ON THIS XZ , ou sur NEW PROFILE si la clé USB en a déjà un. Tapez votre nom de DJ sur le clavier à l’écran, puis appuyez sur NEXT: LOGO . Choisissez une image PNG ou JPEG sur la clé USB, ou NO LOGO . Les images de votre propre dossier DJPROFILE sont listées en premier. Appuyez ensuite sur NEXT: TAGLINE . Tapez quelques mots, comme votre genre, votre ville ou votre crew, puis appuyez sur NEXT: REVIEW . Pour ne pas mettre de slogan, appuyez sur SKIP TAGLINE . Vérifiez le récapitulatif, puis appuyez sur SAVE TO USB 1 ou SAVE TO USB 2 . Un nouveau profil devient le profil actif sur la clé USB où vous l’enregistrez. Seul le dossier DJPROFILE de cette clé USB est écrit. Votre musique, vos playlists et vos stems ne sont pas modifiés. Étape Commandes Nom et slogan Le clavier, SHIFT pour les majuscules, #+= pour les symboles ( ABC pour revenir), SPACE , DELETE , BACK pour l’étape précédente Logo Une ligne par image sur la clé USB, PREV et NEXT pour en voir plus, RESCAN (ou CHECK USB AGAIN ), NO LOGO , KEEP CURRENT quand vous modifiez Récapitulatif CHANGE NAME , CHANGE LOGO , CHANGE TAGLINE , puis SAVE TO USB 1 ou SAVE TO USB 2 Un nom compte jusqu’à 64 caractères et un slogan jusqu’à 80. Avec NO LOGO , votre initiale s’affiche sur la couleur d’accent. Les logos s’affichent en carré sur fond noir. Rien n’est enregistré avant que vous appuyiez sur SAVE. À l’étape du récapitulatif, la ligne du bas indique NOTHING IS SAVED UNTIL YOU PRESS SAVE.

desktop:d5db97f97fc727f8fe10.source: SYNC 1 to SYNC 4: SYNC is on and follows that deck. BPM 1 to BPM 4: only the tempo follows, because QUANTIZE is off, a track has no beat grid, a loop is running, or the beat position is not available. LIMIT: the master tempo is out of reach, so the deck keeps its last tempo. EXT MASTER: a LINK player is master, which decks 3 and 4 cannot follow. NO BPM: analyse the track in your DJ software.
desktop:d5db97f97fc727f8fe10.text: SYNC 1 à SYNC 4: SYNC est en marche et suit ce deck. BPM 1 à BPM 4: Seul le tempo suivit, car QUANTIZE est hors, une piste n'a pas de grille de bat, un boucle est en cours ou la position de bat n'est pas disponible. LIMIT: le tempo maître est hors portée, donc le deck maintient son dernier tempo. EXT MASTER: un joueur LINK est maître, qui les decks 3 et 4 ne peuvent pas suivre. NO BPM: analyse de la piste dans votre logiciel DJ.

manual:086e326b6e5d41258b81.source: PREV , NEXT > Step through the profiles on both USBs. 2 OF 3 shows where you are EDIT Change this profile's name, logo or tagline MAKE ACTIVE Makes this the active profile on its USB. Only the USB is written NEW PROFILE Makes another profile on the USB, for an alias or a back to back set CHECK USB Reads both USB ports again ACTIVE ON THIS USB This profile is the one its USB says is playing SHOWN TO THE VJ NOW This is the profile VJ software sees right now FROM ITS FOLDER IN DJPROFILE A profile made from a folder and a logo OLDER CARD: EDIT IT IN VJ.TOOLS An older profile card. Edit it in VJ.Tools, or make a new profile Your active profile also sits in the MODS header, with its logo and name. Tap it, or highlight it and push, to switch between the profiles on both USBs. Note The player's own saved settings are MY SETTINGS in UTILITY. They are separate from your DJ profile.
manual:086e326b6e5d41258b81.text: PREV , NEXT > Passez par les profils sur les deux USBs. 2 OF 3 montre où vous êtes EDIT Changer le nom, le logo ou la marque de ce profil MAKE ACTIVE Fait ce profil actif sur son USB. Seul le USB est écrit NEW PROFILE Fait un autre profil sur USB, pour un alias ou un ensemble arrière CHECK USB Il lit les deux ports USB à nouveau ACTIVE ON THIS USB Ce profil est celui dont le USB dit est joué SHOWN TO THE VJ NOW C'est le logiciel VJ voit maintenant FROM ITS FOLDER IN DJPROFILE Un profil fait d'un dossier et un logotipe OLDER CARD: EDIT IT IN VJ.TOOLS Une carte de profil plus ancienne. Édit dans VJ.Tools, ou faites un nouveau profil Votre profil actif est également dans le titre MODS, avec son logo et nom. Tapez-le, ou souligne-le et appuyez, pour commuter entre les profils à deux USBs. Note les paramètres sauvés du joueur sont MY SETTINGS dans UTILITY. Ils sont séparés de votre profil DJ.

manual:44747ca2968b85ca6fd6.source: Four decks adds two software players, DECK 3 and DECK 4, to the XDJ-XZ's own DECK 1 and DECK 2. You hear them on mixer channels CH3 and CH4. A short USB cable from the back of the player to a top USB port carries their sound into the mixer: it leaves through a top USB port and comes back in at the rear USB socket, where a computer with DJ software would connect. The physical controls switch between decks with the same presses DJ software uses on the XDJ-XZ.
manual:44747ca2968b85ca6fd6.text: Quatre decks ajoutent deux lecteurs logiciels, DECK 3 et DECK 4, aux DECK 1 et DECK 2 de XDJ-XZ propres. Vous les entendrez sur les canaux de mélange CH3 et CH4. Un court câble USB depuis l'arrière du joueur jusqu'à un port USB supérieur porte son son son dans le mélangeur: il passe par un port USB supérieur et revient dans le socket USB arrière, où un ordinateur avec logiciel DJ se connectera. Le contrôle physique interrupte entre les decks avec les mêmes presses utilisent le logiciel de DJ sur XDJ-XZ.

manual:4925f473ece7eec20df8.text: Les canaux inférieurs suivent toujours le mélangeur, à gauche à droite: CH3, CH1, CH2, CH4. L'ordre mélangeur met les sentiers dans le même ordre, haut en bas. Chaque ligne et chaque canal porte son numéro de deck dans un signe, de sorte que vous pouvez toujours dire quel deck est. Decks 1 et 2 ont un numéro blanc sur gris. Decks 3 et 4 ont un numéros noir sur blanc, comme sur les écrans de jog.

manual:4f6bee5bbe7212fdc004.source: To connect several music sticks, put one high-speed USB 2.0 hub in the top port opposite the loopback cable. Stop or pause decks 1 and 2 while a newly connected hub starts. Connect the sticks to that hub and choose the sources the player makes available. The hub does not add more decks or source buttons.
manual:4f6bee5bbe7212fdc004.text: Pour connecter plusieurs pistes de musique, placez un hub USB 2.0 à grande vitesse dans le port supérieur opposé au câble de retour. Arrêtez ou arrêtez les decks 1 et 2 pendant que un hub nouveau connecté démarre. Connectez les pistes à ce hub et choisissez les sources que le lecteur rend disponible. Le hub n'ajoute pas plus de decks ou boutons source.

manual:5cced1da3c9c850e24cc.source: on the top bar. Open it to see deck 3 and 4 audio render times and active key shifters across all four decks. P99 is the time at or below which 99% of the last 256 rendered blocks finished; MAX is the longest. Short blocks are scaled to a full block. D3+D4 MAX adds both maxima and compares them with the 5,805 microseconds available per block. New shifts use a stricter 3,483 microsecond budget, leaving time for other work. These render numbers include decoding, time stretch and key shift; they do not measure the complete output path. Use them when you suspect the player is working hard, for example with stems on both decks and four decks running.
manual:5cced1da3c9c850e24cc.text: sur la barre supérieure. Ouvrez-le pour voir les temps de reproduction audio deck 3 et 4 et les changements de clé actifs sur les quatre decks. P99 est le moment au cours ou au-dessous où 99% des derniers 256 blocs rendus sont terminés; MAX est le plus long. Les blocs courts sont évolués à un bloc complet. D3+D4 MAX ajoute les deux maximales et les comparaison avec les 5,805 microsecondes disponibles par bloc. Les nouveaux changements utilisent un budget plus strict de 3,483 microseconde, laissant du temps pour les autres travaux. Ces chiffres de reproducteur comprennent le décodage, le détour de temps et le changement de clé; ils ne mesurent pas la voie de sortie complète. Utilisez-les lorsque vous soupçonnez que le joueur travaille dur, par exemple avec des stems sur les deux decks et quatre decks en cours.

manual:66f696237305f7717178.source: The large key in each deck's column is the key the deck plays right now. Tempo with MASTER TEMPO off, a key shift and KEY SYNC all move it. Its colour compares it with the master deck's key. Green means it mixes with the master's key: the same key, its relative major or minor, or one step away on the key wheel, tuned within 25 cents of the master. Amber means it would mix, but it is detuned by more than 25 cents. White means neither, and the master deck itself is always white. Turn KEY MATCH COLOURS off in
manual:66f696237305f7717178.text: La clé importante dans chaque colonne du deck est la clé que le deck joue en ce moment. Tempo avec MASTER TEMPO off, un changement clé et KEY SYNC tout le déplacer. Sa couleur la compare à la clé du deck. Green signifie qu'il mélange avec la clé du maître : la même clé, sa clé relative majeure ou mineure, ou un pas loin sur la roue clé, ajustée dans 25 cents du maître. Amber signifie qu'il se mélange, mais il est détecté par plus de 25 cents. Le blanc ne signifie pas non plus, et le deck maître lui-même est toujours blanc. Retournez KEY MATCH COLOURS dans

manual:680cff455983ca6918b4.source: The left column has one tag per lane. The tag of a deck a side controls is pale blue with LEFT or RIGHT. Decks 1 and 2 show the analysed key, the playing key and its cents. Decks 3 and 4 show their playing key and its cents the same way, TRACK KEY until they report it, or NOT CONNECTED and SEE THE CARD while they are not running.
manual:680cff455983ca6918b4.text: La colonne gauche a une marque par ligne. L'étiquette d'un deck un contrôle côté est bleu bleu bleue avec LEFT ou RIGHT. Decks 1 et 2 montrent la clé analysée, la clé de jeu et ses cents. Decks 3 et 4 montrent leur clé de jouet et ses centi de la même manière, TRACK KEY jusqu'à ce qu'ils le rapportent, ou NOT CONNECTED et SEE THE CARD alors qu'ils ne fonctionnent pas.

manual:e6cccc4ccf08f26a2838.source: Four channels in mixer order 3 1 2 4. Each shows the deck's title, time, QUANTIZE, tempo and range, AUTO CUE and MT, what SYNC follows, what the pads do, the BPM (orange with MASTER for the master deck) and the whole-track overview. A deck that is not connected shows a dim band with NOT CONNECTED and DECK n WAITS FOR THE LOOPBACK CABLE.
manual:e6cccc4ccf08f26a2838.text: Quatre canaux dans l'ordre de mélange 3 1 2 4. Chacun montre le titre du deck, le temps, QUANTIZE, le tempo et la gamme, AUTO CUE et MT, ce que SYNC suit, ce que font les pads, le BPM (orange avec MASTER pour le deck maître) et le panorama de la piste entière. Un deck qui n'est pas connecté montre une bande de dim avec NOT CONNECTED et DECK n WAITS FOR THE LOOPBACK CABLE.

manual:eabd4a87cc18b587a787.source: While decks 3 and 4 are not running, a four-deck view puts a card in their lanes. The card shows the cable steps, the state, and the buttons you need. Decks 1 and 2 stay live above it. In number order the card fills the lanes of decks 3 and 4 under decks 1 and 2. In mixer order it splits into a strip above deck 1 and a strip below deck 2.
manual:eabd4a87cc18b587a787.text: Alors que les decks 3 et 4 ne fonctionnent pas, une vue à quatre decks met une carte dans leurs sentiers. La carte montre les étapes du câble, l'état et les boutons dont vous avez besoin. Les decks 1 et 2 restent vivants au-dessus de lui. En ordre numérique, la carte remplit les sentiers des decks 3 ou 4 sous les decks 1 ou 2. Dans ordre mixteur, elle se divise en une bande au-dessuse du deck 1 et une bande au dessous du deck 2.

manual:dcc7cfcae27bf623ed16.source: While the player records, the diary writes nothing to the stick in USB 2, where the recording goes. Each stick holds at most 4 MiB of diary files. Older segments are replaced first, and the previous session's latest segment is kept when a new session starts. Writing pauses during track loads, RAM copies and heavy USB reads. No diary is created on a read-only stick or when less than 64 MiB of free space plus a small write reserve remains. Read-only test sessions save nothing. Normal USB-loader sessions write diary entries when these conditions allow it. Long busy periods and removal can leave gaps.
manual:dcc7cfcae27bf623ed16.text: Pendant que le lecteur enregistre, le journal n'écrit rien sur la clé dans USB 2, où va l'enregistrement. Chaque stick contient au maximum 4 MiB de fichiers de journal. Les segments anciens sont remplacés d'abord, et le dernier segment de la session précédente est conservé lorsque une nouvelle session commence. Les séances d'écriture sont interrompues pendant les charges de track, RAM copies et USB lectures lourdes. Aucun journal n'est créé sur un stick à lecture uniquement ou lorsque moins de 64 MiB d'espace libre plus une petite réservation d'écrire reste. Les séries de test de lecture uniquement ne économise rien. Les séquences de chargement de USB normales écriront des entrées de journal lorsque ces conditions le permettent. Les périodes longues et la suppression peuvent laisser des lacunes.

manual:814706c5bc388965a639.source: NEEDLE LOCK appears in PLAYER SETTINGS when the player reports it. LOCK prevents a waveform touch from searching a playing deck; when it refuses a touch, the NEEDLE LOCK mark on that deck's overview lights. Pause the deck to search, or choose UNLOCK when that setting is writable.
manual:814706c5bc388965a639.text: NEEDLE LOCK apparaît dans PLAYER SETTINGS quand le lecteur le signale. LOCK empêche qu'un toucher sur la forme d'onde fasse une recherche dans un deck qui joue ; quand il refuse un toucher, la marque NEEDLE LOCK sur la vue d'ensemble de ce deck s'allume. manual:158491ccbdf08c51113b.source: If a download is interrupted or fails verification, the app makes up to three attempts. Each attempt starts again and must pass the same size and checksum checks. If it still fails, the error distinguishes an incomplete download from a checksum mismatch. Check your connection and try again. If it continues, include that error when reporting the problem.
manual:158491ccbdf08c51113b.text: Wenn ein Download unterbrochen wird oder die Prüfung nicht besteht, versucht es die App bis zu dreimal. Jeder Versuch beginnt von vorn und muss dieselben Größen- und Prüfsummenkontrollen bestehen. Schlägt er weiter fehl, unterscheidet der Fehler einen unvollständigen Download von einer abweichenden Prüfsumme. Prüfen Sie Ihre Verbindung und versuchen Sie es erneut. Wenn es weiter passiert, geben Sie diesen Fehler an, wenn Sie das Problem melden.

manual:128e0d464559fce231fb.source: In OverCue Desktop's Settings, choose the 44.1 kHz FLAC stems option. The XZ plays at 44.1 kHz, so it copies these stems straight into memory. A track's stems are ready sooner, the player does less work while it plays, and the stems take less space on the USB.
manual:128e0d464559fce231fb.text: Wählen Sie in den Einstellungen von OverCue Desktop die Option für Stems in 44.1 kHz FLAC. Der XZ gibt Audio mit 44.1 kHz wieder und kopiert diese Stems deshalb direkt in den Speicher. Die Stems eines Tracks sind früher bereit, der Player muss während der Wiedergabe weniger arbeiten, und die Stems brauchen weniger Platz auf dem USB-Stick.

manual:3e0dc792b8c0b7aaefe2.source: OverCue's default is 96 kHz. These stems still play, but the XZ has to convert them while it plays. That takes about a third of one processor core per deck, and they take longer to become ready. With four decks playing, they become ready more slowly than the track plays.
manual:3e0dc792b8c0b7aaefe2.text: Die Standardeinstellung von OverCue ist 96 kHz. Diese Stems werden trotzdem abgespielt, aber der XZ muss sie während der Wiedergabe umrechnen. Das beansprucht pro Deck etwa ein Drittel eines Prozessorkerns, und die Stems brauchen länger, bis sie bereit sind. Wenn vier Decks spielen, werden die Stems langsamer bereitgestellt, als der Track abgespielt wird.

manual:1ae5debbd341fb1d9a70.source: XZ Mods is software for the XDJ-XZ that starts from a USB stick. It adds a MODS menu, stems you can mute live, custom beat jump, four decks over a loopback cable, DJ profiles, themes and games. It can also replace the whole play screen with its own MODERN interface.
manual:1ae5debbd341fb1d9a70.text: XZ Mods ist eine Software für die XDJ-XZ mit einem USB-Stick. Es fügt ein MODS-Menü hinzu, Stems, die Sie live muten können, benutzerdefinierte Beat-Jump, vier Decks über ein loopback-Kabel, DJ-Profile, Themen und Spiele. Es kann auch den gesamten Play-Bildschirm mit seiner eigenen MODERN-Schnittstelle ersetzen.

manual:20c2c0d610472848b864.source: PREV Tap MAKE ACTIVE Open CONNECT › DJ PROFILE . Push CREATE ON THIS XZ , or NEW PROFILE if the USB already has one. Type your DJ name on the on-screen keyboard, then push NEXT: LOGO . Pick a PNG or JPEG image from the USB, or NO LOGO . Images in your own DJPROFILE folder are listed first. Then push NEXT: TAGLINE . Type a few words, such as your genre, city or crew, and push NEXT: REVIEW . To leave the tagline out, push SKIP TAGLINE . Check the review, then push SAVE TO USB 1 or SAVE TO USB 2 . A new profile becomes the active profile on the USB you save it to. Only the DJPROFILE folder on that USB is written. Your music, playlists and stems are not touched. Step Controls Name and tagline The keyboard, SHIFT for capitals, #+= for symbols ( ABC goes back), SPACE , DELETE , BACK to the step before Logo One row per image on the USB, PREV and NEXT for more, RESCAN (or CHECK USB AGAIN ), NO LOGO , KEEP CURRENT when you edit Review CHANGE NAME , CHANGE LOGO , CHANGE TAGLINE , then SAVE TO USB 1 or SAVE TO USB 2 A name holds up to 64 characters and a tagline up to 80. With NO LOGO , your initial is shown on the accent colour. Logos are shown square over black. Nothing is saved until you push SAVE. The bottom line says NOTHING IS SAVED UNTIL YOU PRESS SAVE on the review step.
manual:20c2c0d610472848b864.text: PREV Tippen Sie auf MAKE ACTIVE Öffnen Sie CONNECT › DJ PROFILE . Drücken Sie CREATE ON THIS XZ oder NEW PROFILE, wenn der USB-Stick schon eines hat. Geben Sie Ihren DJ-Namen auf der Bildschirmtastatur ein und drücken Sie dann NEXT: LOGO . Wählen Sie ein PNG- oder JPEG-Bild vom USB-Stick oder NO LOGO . Bilder in Ihrem eigenen DJPROFILE-Ordner stehen zuerst. Drücken Sie dann NEXT: TAGLINE . Geben Sie ein paar Wörter ein, etwa Ihr Genre, Ihre Stadt oder Ihre Crew, und drücken Sie NEXT: REVIEW . Um die Tagline wegzulassen, drücken Sie SKIP TAGLINE . Prüfen Sie die Übersicht und drücken Sie dann SAVE TO USB 1 oder SAVE TO USB 2 . Ein neues Profil wird zum aktiven Profil auf dem USB-Stick, auf dem Sie es speichern. Nur der DJPROFILE-Ordner auf diesem USB-Stick wird beschrieben. Ihre Musik, Playlists und Stems bleiben unberührt. Schritt Bedienelemente Name und Tagline Die Tastatur, SHIFT für Großbuchstaben, #+= für Symbole ( ABC geht zurück), SPACE , DELETE , BACK zum vorherigen Schritt Logo Eine Zeile pro Bild auf dem USB-Stick, PREV und NEXT für mehr, RESCAN (oder CHECK USB AGAIN ), NO LOGO , KEEP CURRENT beim Bearbeiten Übersicht CHANGE NAME , CHANGE LOGO , CHANGE TAGLINE , dann SAVE TO USB 1 oder SAVE TO USB 2 Ein Name fasst bis zu 64 Zeichen, eine Tagline bis zu 80. Mit NO LOGO wird Ihr Anfangsbuchstabe auf der Akzentfarbe gezeigt. Logos werden quadratisch auf Schwarz gezeigt. Nichts wird gespeichert, bevor Sie SAVE drücken. Die unterste Zeile zeigt im Übersichtsschritt NOTHING IS SAVED UNTIL YOU PRESS SAVE.

D is BYPASS: it plays the original track instead of the stems. On a 4-stem track, D mutes bass instead. With the E-H bank, E to H do the same.
manual:309bd86e6dfe608aa6a6.text: Im Pad-Modus, den Sie für Stems wählen, schalten vier Pads Stems auf diesem Deck. A, B und C mutieren die drei Stems in Ihrem STEM ORDER. D ist BYPASS: es spielt die ursprüngliche Track anstelle der Stems. Auf einem 4-Stem-Track mutiert D bas. Mit der E-H Bank tun E bis H das gleiche.

manual:5cced1da3c9c850e24cc.source: on the top bar. Open it to see deck 3 and 4 audio render times and active key shifters across all four decks. P99 is the time at or below which 99% of the last 256 rendered blocks finished; MAX is the longest. Short blocks are scaled to a full block. D3+D4 MAX adds both maxima and compares them with the 5,805 microseconds available per block. New shifts use a stricter 3,483 microsecond budget, leaving time for other work. These render numbers include decoding, time stretch and key shift; they do not measure the complete output path. Use them when you suspect the player is working hard, for example with stems on both decks and four decks running.
manual:5cced1da3c9c850e24cc.text: auf der oberen Bar. Öffnen Sie es, um Deck 3 und 4 Audio-Renderzeiten und aktive Schlüsselschalter in allen vier Decks zu sehen. P99 ist die Zeit, an der 99% der letzten 256 abgegebenen Blöcke abgeschlossen sind; MAX ist die längste. Kurze Blöcke werden auf ein vollständiges Block ausgelöst. D3+D4 MAX fügt beide Maximum hinzu und vergleicht sie mit den verfügbaren 5,805 Mikrosekunden pro Block. Neue Schüssen verwenden ein strengeres Budget von 3,483 Mikrosekund, so dass Zeit für andere Arbeit. Diese Render-Nummer umfassen Decodierung, Zeitstrecken und Schlüsselwechsel; sie messen nicht den vollständigen Ausgangspaz. Verwenden Sie sie, wenn Sie vermuten, dass der Spieler hart arbeitet, z. B. mit Stems in beiden Decks und vier Decks laufen.

Wenn Sie KEY CPU LIMIT sehen, drücken Sie RESET auf der Seite KEYS für das Deck, das den Schlüsseln hält, dann versuchen Sie es erneut. [[SHIFT]] + [[SYNC]] oder [[MASTER TEMPO]] endet KEY SYNC.

desktop:d5db97f97fc727f8fe10.source: SYNC 1 to SYNC 4: SYNC is on and follows that deck. BPM 1 to BPM 4: only the tempo follows, because QUANTIZE is off, a track has no beat grid, a loop is running, or the beat position is not available. LIMIT: the master tempo is out of reach, so the deck keeps its last tempo. EXT MASTER: a LINK player is master, which decks 3 and 4 cannot follow. NO BPM: analyse the track in your DJ software.
desktop:d5db97f97fc727f8fe10.text: SYNC 1 bis SYNC 4: SYNC ist auf und folgt diesem Deck. BPM 1 bis BPM 4: Nur der Tempo folgt, weil QUANTIZE ausgeschaltet ist, eine Spur hat kein Beat-Get, ein Loop läuft oder die Beat-Position nicht verfügbar ist. LIMIT: Der Master Tempo ist nicht bereitzustellen, so dass das Deck seine letzte Tempo hält. EXT MASTER: ein LINK-Player ist Master, den Decks 3 und 4 nicht folgen können. NO BPM: Analyse des Spur in Ihrer DJ-Software.

manual:086e326b6e5d41258b81.source: PREV , NEXT > Step through the profiles on both USBs. 2 OF 3 shows where you are EDIT Change this profile's name, logo or tagline MAKE ACTIVE Makes this the active profile on its USB. Only the USB is written NEW PROFILE Makes another profile on the USB, for an alias or a back to back set CHECK USB Reads both USB ports again ACTIVE ON THIS USB This profile is the one its USB says is playing SHOWN TO THE VJ NOW This is the profile VJ software sees right now FROM ITS FOLDER IN DJPROFILE A profile made from a folder and a logo OLDER CARD: EDIT IT IN VJ.TOOLS An older profile card. Edit it in VJ.Tools, or make a new profile Your active profile also sits in the MODS header, with its logo and name. Tap it, or highlight it and push, to switch between the profiles on both USBs. Note The player's own saved settings are MY SETTINGS in UTILITY. They are separate from your DJ profile.
manual:086e326b6e5d41258b81.text: PREV , NEXT > Schritt durch die Profile auf beiden USBs. 2 OF 3 zeigt, wo Sie sind EDIT Ändern Sie den Namen dieses Profils, Logo oder Taglinie MAKE ACTIVE macht dies das aktive Profil auf seiner USB. Nur die USB wird geschrieben NEW PROFILE Erstellt ein anderes Profil auf der USB, für ein alias oder ein Rücken-Set CHECK USB Lesen beide USB Ports wieder ACTIVE ON THIS USB Dieses Profil ist das, was seine USB sagt ist, spielt SHOWN TO THE VJ NOW Dies ist das Profil VJ Software sieht jetzt FROM ITS FOLDER IN DJPROFILE Ein Profil aus einem Ordner und einem Logo OLDER CARD: EDIT IT IN VJ.TOOLS Ein älterer Profil. Bearbeiten Sie es in VJ.Tools oder erstellen Sie ein neues Profil Dein aktive Profil sitzt auch in der MODS-Heiter, mit seinem Logo und Namen. Tasten Sie es, oder markieren es und drücken, um zwischen den Profilen auf beiden USBs zu wechseln. Hinweis Die eigenen gespeicherten Einstellungen des Spielers sind MY SETTINGS in UTILITY. Sie sind getrennt von Ihrem DJ-Profil.

manual:44747ca2968b85ca6fd6.source: Four decks adds two software players, DECK 3 and DECK 4, to the XDJ-XZ's own DECK 1 and DECK 2. You hear them on mixer channels CH3 and CH4. A short USB cable from the back of the player to a top USB port carries their sound into the mixer: it leaves through a top USB port and comes back in at the rear USB socket, where a computer with DJ software would connect. The physical controls switch between decks with the same presses DJ software uses on the XDJ-XZ.
manual:44747ca2968b85ca6fd6.text: Vier Decks fügen zwei Software-Player, DECK 3 und DECK 4, zu den XDJ-XZ eigenen DECK 1 und DECK 2. Sie hören sie auf den Mixerkanäle CH3 und CH4. Ein kurzes USB Kabel von der Rückseite des Spiels bis zu einem Top USB Port bringt ihren Sound in den Mixer: es läuft durch einen Top USB Port und kommt zurück in den Rücken USB Socket, wo ein Computer mit DJ-Software verbunden würde. Die physischen Steuerung schaltet zwischen Decks mit dem gleichen Druck DJ-Source auf der XDJ-XZ.

manual:4925f473ece7eec20df8.source: The bottom channels always follow the mixer, left to right: CH3, CH1, CH2, CH4. Mixer order puts the lanes in the same order, top to bottom. Each lane and each channel carries its deck's number in a badge, so you can always tell which deck is which. Decks 1 and 2 have a white number on grey. Decks 3 and 4 have a black number on white, as on the jog displays.
manual:4925f473ece7eec20df8.text: Die untenen Kanäle folgen immer dem Mixer, links nach rechts: CH3, CH1, CH2, CH4. Die Mixer-Ordnung setzt die Strecken in der gleichen Reihenfolge, oben nach unten. Jeder Lane und jeder Kanal trägt seine Deck-Nummer in einem Badge, so dass Sie immer sagen können, welcher Deck ist. Decks 1 und 2 haben eine weiße Nummer auf dem Grauen. Decks 3 und 4 haben eine schwarze Nummer auf dem Weißen, wie auf den Jog-Display.

manual:4f6bee5bbe7212fdc004.source: To connect several music sticks, put one high-speed USB 2.0 hub in the top port opposite the loopback cable. Stop or pause decks 1 and 2 while a newly connected hub starts. Connect the sticks to that hub and choose the sources the player makes available. The hub does not add more decks or source buttons.
manual:4f6bee5bbe7212fdc004.text: Um mehrere Musikstücke zu verbinden, legen Sie einen High-Speed USB 2.0 Hub im oberen Port gegenüber dem Laufback-Kabel. Stoppen oder pausen Decks 1 und 2, während ein neu verbundenes Hub startet. Verbinden Sie die Stücke mit diesem Hub und wählen Sie die Quellen, die der Player zur Verfügung stellt. Das Hub fügt keine weiteren Decks oder Quellknöpfe hinzu.

manual:62a43847aca915aa72a9.source: Turn the side while the deck plays to bend its speed. The faster you turn, the more it bends, so a gentle nudge moves it only a little. With VINYL on, scratch on the platter top. For a backspin, spin the platter and let go: the deck follows the platter until it stops, then plays on.
manual:62a43847aca915aa72a9.text: Drehen Sie die Seite, während das Deck spielt, um seine Geschwindigkeit zu beben. Je schneller Sie drehen, desto mehr beben Sie sich, so bewegt eine sanfte Nudge ihn nur ein wenig. Mit VINYL auf, schraubt auf der Spitze der Platte. Für einen Rücken, drehen Sie die Platte und lassen Sie gehen: Das Deck folgt der Platte, bis es stoppt, dann spielt auf.

manual:66f696237305f7717178.source: The large key in each deck's column is the key the deck plays right now. Tempo with MASTER TEMPO off, a key shift and KEY SYNC all move it. Its colour compares it with the master deck's key. Green means it mixes with the master's key: the same key, its relative major or minor, or one step away on the key wheel, tuned within 25 cents of the master. Amber means it would mix, but it is detuned by more than 25 cents. White means neither, and the master deck itself is always white. Turn KEY MATCH COLOURS off in
manual:66f696237305f7717178.text: Der große Schlüssel in jeder Spalte des Decks ist der Schlüssel, den das Deck gerade spielt. Tempo mit MASTER TEMPO off, ein Schlüsselwechsel und KEY SYNC alle bewegt es. Seine Farbe vergleicht sie mit dem Schlüssel des Master Deck. Grün bedeutet, dass es mit dem Schlüssel des Meisters gemischt wird: der gleiche Schlüssel, sein relativ großer oder kleiner, oder einen Schritt weg vom Schlüsselrad, der innerhalb von 25 Cent des Meistern eingerichtet wird. Amber bedeutet, dass es mischen würde, aber es wird um mehr als 25 Cent zerstört. Weiß bedeutet auch nicht, und das Deck selbst ist immer weiß. Setzen Sie KEY MATCH COLOURS aus

Decks 3 und 4 benötigen ein verbundener Laufback-Kabel, um eine Kopie zu starten.

manual:eabd4a87cc18b587a787.source: While decks 3 and 4 are not running, a four-deck view puts a card in their lanes. The card shows the cable steps, the state, and the buttons you need. Decks 1 and 2 stay live above it. In number order the card fills the lanes of decks 3 and 4 under decks 1 and 2. In mixer order it splits into a strip above deck 1 and a strip below deck 2.
manual:eabd4a87cc18b587a787.text: Während Decks 3 und 4 nicht funktionieren, stellt eine Vier-Deck-Ansicht eine Karte in ihre Strecken. Die Karte zeigt die Kabelschritte, den Zustand und die Knöpfe, die Sie benötigen. Decks 1 und 2 bleiben direkt über ihr. In Nummerfolge füllt die Karte die Strecken von Decks 3 und 4, unter Decks 1 und 2. In Mixer-Reihe wird sie in eine Streifen über Deck 1 und eine Streifen unter Deck 2 aufgeteilt.

manual:dcc7cfcae27bf623ed16.source: While the player records, the diary writes nothing to the stick in USB 2, where the recording goes. Each stick holds at most 4 MiB of diary files. Older segments are replaced first, and the previous session's latest segment is kept when a new session starts. Writing pauses during track loads, RAM copies and heavy USB reads. No diary is created on a read-only stick or when less than 64 MiB of free space plus a small write reserve remains. Read-only test sessions save nothing. Normal USB-loader sessions write diary entries when these conditions allow it. Long busy periods and removal can leave gaps.
manual:dcc7cfcae27bf623ed16.text: Während der Player aufnimmt, schreibt das Tagebuch nichts auf den Stick in USB 2, wohin die Aufnahme geht. Jeder Stick hält höchstens 4 MiB Tagedateien. Ältere Segmente werden zuerst ersetzt, und das neueste Segment der vorherigen Sitzung wird beibehalten, wenn eine neue Sitzung beginnt. Schreibenpausen während Tracklasten, RAM Kopien und schwerer USB Lesungen. Kein Tagebuch wird auf einem Read-on Stick erstellt oder wenn weniger als 64 MiB freier Platz plus ein kleines Schreibreserven bleibt. Lesen-on-Test-Sitzungen sparen nichts. Normaler USB-Ladersitzungen schreiben Tagebuchteinsätze, wenn diese Bedingungen es erlauben. Lang beschäftigt Perioden und Entfernung können Lücken hinterlassen.

manual:814706c5bc388965a639.source: NEEDLE LOCK appears in PLAYER SETTINGS when the player reports it. LOCK prevents a waveform touch from searching a playing deck; when it refuses a touch, the NEEDLE LOCK mark on that deck's overview lights. Pause the deck to search, or choose UNLOCK when that setting is writable.
manual:814706c5bc388965a639.text: NEEDLE LOCK erscheint unter PLAYER SETTINGS, wenn der Player es meldet. LOCK verhindert, dass eine Berührung der Wellenform in einem spielenden Deck sucht; verweigert es eine Berührung, leuchtet die NEEDLE LOCK-Marke auf der Übersicht dieses Decks auf. Pausieren Sie das Deck zum Suchen, oder wählen Sie UNLOCK, wenn diese Einstellung änderbar ist.

manual:158491ccbdf08c51113b.source: If a download is interrupted or fails verification, the app makes up to three attempts. Each attempt starts again and must pass the same size and checksum checks. If it still fails, the error distinguishes an incomplete download from a checksum mismatch. Check your connection and try again. If it continues, include that error when reporting the problem.
manual:158491ccbdf08c51113b.text: Se um download for interrompido ou falhar na verificação, o app faz até três tentativas. Cada tentativa recomeça e precisa passar pelas mesmas verificações de tamanho e de checksum. Se ainda falhar, o erro diferencia um download incompleto de um checksum que não confere. Verifique sua conexão e tente de novo. Se continuar, inclua esse erro ao relatar o problema.

manual:128e0d464559fce231fb.source: In OverCue Desktop's Settings, choose the 44.1 kHz FLAC stems option. The XZ plays at 44.1 kHz, so it copies these stems straight into memory. A track's stems are ready sooner, the player does less work while it plays, and the stems take less space on the USB.
manual:128e0d464559fce231fb.text: Nas Configurações do OverCue Desktop, escolha a opção de stems FLAC em 44.1 kHz. O XZ toca em 44.1 kHz, então copia esses stems direto para a memória. Os stems de uma faixa ficam prontos mais cedo, o player trabalha menos enquanto toca e os stems ocupam menos espaço no USB.

manual:3e0dc792b8c0b7aaefe2.source: OverCue's default is 96 kHz. These stems still play, but the XZ has to convert them while it plays. That takes about a third of one processor core per deck, and they take longer to become ready. With four decks playing, they become ready more slowly than the track plays.
manual:3e0dc792b8c0b7aaefe2.text: O padrão do OverCue é 96 kHz. Esses stems também tocam, mas o XZ precisa convertê-los enquanto toca. Isso consome cerca de um terço de um núcleo do processador por deck, e os stems demoram mais para ficar prontos. Com quatro decks tocando, eles ficam prontos mais devagar do que a faixa toca.

manual:20c2c0d610472848b864.source: PREV Tap MAKE ACTIVE Open CONNECT › DJ PROFILE . Push CREATE ON THIS XZ , or NEW PROFILE if the USB already has one. Type your DJ name on the on-screen keyboard, then push NEXT: LOGO . Pick a PNG or JPEG image from the USB, or NO LOGO . Images in your own DJPROFILE folder are listed first. Then push NEXT: TAGLINE . Type a few words, such as your genre, city or crew, and push NEXT: REVIEW . To leave the tagline out, push SKIP TAGLINE . Check the review, then push SAVE TO USB 1 or SAVE TO USB 2 . A new profile becomes the active profile on the USB you save it to. Only the DJPROFILE folder on that USB is written. Your music, playlists and stems are not touched. Step Controls Name and tagline The keyboard, SHIFT for capitals, #+= for symbols ( ABC goes back), SPACE , DELETE , BACK to the step before Logo One row per image on the USB, PREV and NEXT for more, RESCAN (or CHECK USB AGAIN ), NO LOGO , KEEP CURRENT when you edit Review CHANGE NAME , CHANGE LOGO , CHANGE TAGLINE , then SAVE TO USB 1 or SAVE TO USB 2 A name holds up to 64 characters and a tagline up to 80. With NO LOGO , your initial is shown on the accent colour. Logos are shown square over black. Nothing is saved until you push SAVE. The bottom line says NOTHING IS SAVED UNTIL YOU PRESS SAVE on the review step.
manual:20c2c0d610472848b864.text: PREV Tapio MAKE ACTIVE Open CONNECT › DJ PROFILE . Push CREATE ON THIS XZ ou NEW PROFILE se o USB já tiver um. Digite o seu nome de DJ no teclado na tela e, em seguida, pressione NEXT: LOGO. Escolha uma imagem PNG ou JPEG do USB, ou NO LOGO. As imagens em sua própria pasta DJPROFILE são listadas em primeiro lugar. Em seguida, pressione NEXT: TAGLINE . Digite algumas palavras, como seu gênero, cidade ou tripulação, e pressione NEXT: REVIEW . Para deixar a tagline fora, pressione SKIP TAGLINE . Verifique a revisão e pressione SAVE TO USB 1 ou SAVE TO USB 2 . Um novo perfil se torna o perfil ativo no USB em que você o salve. Apenas a pasta DJPROFILE neste USB é escrita. Sua música, playlists e stems não são tocados. Controle de passos Nome e etiqueta O teclado, SHIFT para os capitais, #+= para os símbolos ( ABC vai de volta), SPACE , DELETE , BACK para o passo antes do Logotipo Uma linha por imagem no USB, PREV e NEXT para mais, RESCAN (ou CHECK USB AGAIN ), NO LOGO , KEEP CURRENT quando você edita Revisão CHANGE NAME, CHANGE LOGO , CHANGE TAGLINE , em seguida, SAVE TO USB 1 ou SAVE TO USB 2 Um nome tem até 64 caracteres e uma linha de etiqueta até 80. Com NO LOGO , o seu inicial é mostrado na cor do acento. Os logos são mostrados quadrados acima do preto. Nada é salvo até que você pressione SAVE. A linha inferior diz NOTHING IS SAVED UNTIL YOU PRESS SAVE na etapa de revisão.

manual:5cced1da3c9c850e24cc.source: on the top bar. Open it to see deck 3 and 4 audio render times and active key shifters across all four decks. P99 is the time at or below which 99% of the last 256 rendered blocks finished; MAX is the longest. Short blocks are scaled to a full block. D3+D4 MAX adds both maxima and compares them with the 5,805 microseconds available per block. New shifts use a stricter 3,483 microsecond budget, leaving time for other work. These render numbers include decoding, time stretch and key shift; they do not measure the complete output path. Use them when you suspect the player is working hard, for example with stems on both decks and four decks running.
manual:5cced1da3c9c850e24cc.text: na barra superior. Abra-o para ver decks 3 e 4 tempos de renderização de áudio e mudadores de chave ativos em todos os quatro decks. P99 é o tempo em ou abaixo em que 99% dos últimos 256 blocos renderizados terminaram; MAX é o mais longo. Blocos curtos são escalados para um bloco completo. D3+D4 MAX adiciona ambos o máximo e compara-os com os 5,805 microsecundos disponíveis por bloco. Novos mudos usam um orçamento mais rígido de 3,483 microsecondos, deixando tempo para outro trabalho. Estes números de rendering incluem decodificação, alongamento de tempo e mudança de chave; eles não medem a rota de saída completa. Use-os quando suspeita que o jogador está trabalhando duro, por exemplo com stems em ambos decks e quatro decks executados.

Se você ver KEY CPU LIMIT, pressione RESET na página KEYS para o deck que mantém a mudança, então tente novamente. [[SHIFT]] + [[SYNC]] ou [[MASTER TEMPO]] termina KEY SYNC.

desktop:d5db97f97fc727f8fe10.source: SYNC 1 to SYNC 4: SYNC is on and follows that deck. BPM 1 to BPM 4: only the tempo follows, because QUANTIZE is off, a track has no beat grid, a loop is running, or the beat position is not available. LIMIT: the master tempo is out of reach, so the deck keeps its last tempo. EXT MASTER: a LINK player is master, which decks 3 and 4 cannot follow. NO BPM: analyse the track in your DJ software.
desktop:d5db97f97fc727f8fe10.text: SYNC 1 a SYNC 4: SYNC está em e segue aquele deck. BPM 1 a BPM 4: só o tempo segue, porque QUANTIZE está desligado, uma pista não tem rede de batimento, um loop está em marcha, ou a posição de batimento não está disponível. LIMIT: o tempo mestre está fora do alcance, então o deck mantém seu último tempo. EXT MASTER: um jogador LINK é mestre, que decks 3 e 4 não podem seguir. NO BPM: analisar a pista no seu software DJ.
