manual:086e326b6e5d41258b81.source: PREV , NEXT > Step through the profiles on both USBs. 2 OF 3 shows where you are EDIT Change this profile's name, logo or tagline MAKE ACTIVE Makes this the active profile on its USB. Only the USB is written NEW PROFILE Makes another profile on the USB, for an alias or a back to back set CHECK USB Reads both USB ports again ACTIVE ON THIS USB This profile is the one its USB says is playing SHOWN TO THE VJ NOW This is the profile VJ software sees right now FROM ITS FOLDER IN DJPROFILE A profile made from a folder and a logo OLDER CARD: EDIT IT IN VJ.TOOLS An older profile card. Edit it in VJ.Tools, or make a new profile Your active profile also sits in the MODS header, with its logo and name. Tap it, or highlight it and push, to switch between the profiles on both USBs. Note The player's own saved settings are MY SETTINGS in UTILITY. They are separate from your DJ profile.
manual:086e326b6e5d41258b81.text: PREV , NEXT > Passe através dos perfis em ambos USBs. 2 OF 3 mostra onde você está EDIT Alterar o nome deste perfil, logotipo ou etiqueta MAKE ACTIVE Faz isso o perfil ativo em seu USB. Só o USB é escrito NEW PROFILE Faz outro perfil no USB, para um alias ou um set de volta para trás CHECK USB Leia ambas portas USB novamente ACTIVE ON THIS USB Este perfil é o que seu USB diz que está jogando SHOWN TO THE VJ NOW Este é o perfil VJ software vê agora FROM ITS FOLDER IN DJPROFILE Um perfil feito de uma pasta e um logotipo OLDER CARD: EDIT IT IN VJ.TOOLS Um cartão de perfil mais velho. Editar em VJ.Tools, ou criar um novo perfil Seu perfil ativo também está no cabeçal MODS, com seu logotipo e nome. toque, ou destacar e empurr, para trocar entre os perfis em ambas as USBs. Observe que as configurações salvas do jogador são MY SETTINGS em UTILITY. Eles são separados do seu perfil DJ.

manual:2392017bed94268c937d.source: When you pause the master, MASTER passes at once to the next playing deck. A deck with SYNC on comes first. Otherwise after deck 3 comes deck 4, then decks 1 and 2. After deck 4 come decks 1 and 2, then deck 3. In VINYL mode MASTER passes when you press pause, while the deck slows down.
manual:2392017bed94268c937d.text: Quando você interrompe o mestre, MASTER passa de uma vez para o próximo deck jogando. Um deck com SYNC on vem primeiro. Caso contrário, após o deck 3 vem o deck 4, então os decks 1 e 2. Depois do deck 4 vêm decks 1 and 2, então o deck 3. No modo VINYL MASTER passa quando você pressiona a pausa, enquanto o deck desacelera.

manual:44747ca2968b85ca6fd6.source: Four decks adds two software players, DECK 3 and DECK 4, to the XDJ-XZ's own DECK 1 and DECK 2. You hear them on mixer channels CH3 and CH4. A short USB cable from the back of the player to a top USB port carries their sound into the mixer: it leaves through a top USB port and comes back in at the rear USB socket, where a computer with DJ software would connect. The physical controls switch between decks with the same presses DJ software uses on the XDJ-XZ.
manual:44747ca2968b85ca6fd6.text: Quatro decks adicionam dois jogadores de software, DECK 3 e DECK 4, às XDJ-XZ próprias DECK 1 e DECK 2. Você ouve-os nos canais de mistura CH3 e CH4. Um curto cabo USB da parte traseira do jogador para uma porta superior USB leva seu som ao misturador: ele deixa através de uma porta superior de USB e vem de volta ao socote USB traseiro, onde um computador com software DJ se conectaria. Os controlos físicos interruptores entre decks com os mesmos pressões que o software DJ utiliza no XDJ-XZ.

manual:4925f473ece7eec20df8.source: The bottom channels always follow the mixer, left to right: CH3, CH1, CH2, CH4. Mixer order puts the lanes in the same order, top to bottom. Each lane and each channel carries its deck's number in a badge, so you can always tell which deck is which. Decks 1 and 2 have a white number on grey. Decks 3 and 4 have a black number on white, as on the jog displays.
manual:4925f473ece7eec20df8.text: Os canais abaixo sempre seguem o misturador, à esquerda para a direita: CH3, CH1, CH2, CH4. A ordem do misturador coloca as trilhas na mesma ordem, superior para baixo. Cada linha e cada canal carrega seu número de deck em um selo, para que você possa sempre dizer qual deck é. Decks 1 e 2 têm um número branco em cinza. Decks 3 e 4 têm um número preto em branco, como na tela jog.

manual:66f696237305f7717178.source: The large key in each deck's column is the key the deck plays right now. Tempo with MASTER TEMPO off, a key shift and KEY SYNC all move it. Its colour compares it with the master deck's key. Green means it mixes with the master's key: the same key, its relative major or minor, or one step away on the key wheel, tuned within 25 cents of the master. Amber means it would mix, but it is detuned by more than 25 cents. White means neither, and the master deck itself is always white. Turn KEY MATCH COLOURS off in
manual:66f696237305f7717178.text: A grande chave em cada coluna de deck é a chave que o deck joga atualmente. Tempo com MASTER TEMPO off, uma mudança chave e KEY SYNC todos movê-lo. manual:e6cccc4ccf08f26a2838.source: Four channels in mixer order 3 1 2 4. Each shows the deck's title, time, QUANTIZE, tempo and range, AUTO CUE and MT, what SYNC follows, what the pads do, the BPM (orange with MASTER for the master deck) and the whole-track overview. A deck that is not connected shows a dim band with NOT CONNECTED and DECK n WAITS FOR THE LOOPBACK CABLE.

Cada um mostra o título do deck, tempo, QUANTIZE, tempo e alcance, AUTO CUE e MT, o que SYNC segue, o que os pads fazem, o BPM (laranja com MASTER para o deck mestre) e a visão geral da pista inteira. Um deck que não está conectado mostra uma banda de frio com NOT CONNECTED e DECK n WAITS FOR THE LOOPBACK CABLE.

manual:eabd4a87cc18b587a787.text: Embora os decks 3 e 4 não funcionem, uma visão de quatro decks coloca um cartão em suas trilhas. O cartão mostra os passos do cabo, o estado e os botões que você precisa. Decks 1 e 2 ficarem vivos acima dele. Em ordem número o cartão preenche as trilhas dos decks 3 ou 4 sob decks 1 e 2. Em ordem de misturador, ele se divide em uma cinta acima do deck 1 e uma cinta abaixo do deck 2.

manual:dcc7cfcae27bf623ed16.source: While the player records, the diary writes nothing to the stick in USB 2, where the recording goes. Each stick holds at most 4 MiB of diary files. Older segments are replaced first, and the previous session's latest segment is kept when a new session starts. Writing pauses during track loads, RAM copies and heavy USB reads. No diary is created on a read-only stick or when less than 64 MiB of free space plus a small write reserve remains. Read-only test sessions save nothing. Normal USB-loader sessions write diary entries when these conditions allow it. Long busy periods and removal can leave gaps.
manual:dcc7cfcae27bf623ed16.text: Enquanto o player grava, o diário não escreve nada no pen drive do USB 2, onde vai a gravação. Cada stick mantém o máximo de 4 MiB de arquivos de diário. Os segmentos mais velhos são substituídos primeiro, e o último segmento da sessão anterior é mantido quando uma nova sessão começa. Escreva interrupções durante cargas de pista, RAM cópias e USB leitura pesada. Nenhum diário é criado em uma stick só leitura ou quando menos de 64 MiB de espaço livre, além de uma pequena reserva de escrita permanece. sessões de teste de leitura só salvam nada. sessões normais de carga USB escrever entradas de diário quando essas condições permitem. Períodos longos ocupados e remoção podem deixar lacunas.

manual:158491ccbdf08c51113b.source: If a download is interrupted or fails verification, the app makes up to three attempts. Each attempt starts again and must pass the same size and checksum checks. If it still fails, the error distinguishes an incomplete download from a checksum mismatch. Check your connection and try again. If it continues, include that error when reporting the problem.
manual:158491ccbdf08c51113b.text: Se un download si interrompe o non supera la verifica, l'app fa fino a tre tentativi. Ogni tentativo riparte da capo e deve superare gli stessi controlli di dimensione e checksum. Se fallisce ancora, l'errore distingue un download incompleto da un checksum che non corrisponde. Controlla la connessione e riprova. Se continua, includi quell'errore quando segnali il problema.

manual:128e0d464559fce231fb.source: In OverCue Desktop's Settings, choose the 44.1 kHz FLAC stems option. The XZ plays at 44.1 kHz, so it copies these stems straight into memory. A track's stems are ready sooner, the player does less work while it plays, and the stems take less space on the USB.
manual:128e0d464559fce231fb.text: Nelle Impostazioni di OverCue Desktop, scegli l'opzione per gli stem FLAC a 44.1 kHz. L'XZ riproduce a 44.1 kHz, quindi copia questi stem direttamente in memoria. Gli stem di una traccia sono pronti prima, il lettore lavora meno durante la riproduzione e gli stem occupano meno spazio sulla chiavetta USB.

manual:3e0dc792b8c0b7aaefe2.source: OverCue's default is 96 kHz. These stems still play, but the XZ has to convert them while it plays. That takes about a third of one processor core per deck, and they take longer to become ready. With four decks playing, they become ready more slowly than the track plays.
manual:3e0dc792b8c0b7aaefe2.text: Il valore predefinito di OverCue è 96 kHz. Questi stem vengono comunque riprodotti, ma l'XZ deve convertirli durante la riproduzione. Questo richiede circa un terzo di un core del processore per deck, e gli stem impiegano più tempo a essere pronti. Con quattro deck in riproduzione, vengono preparati più lentamente di quanto avanzi la riproduzione della traccia.

manual:20c2c0d610472848b864.source: PREV Tap MAKE ACTIVE Open CONNECT › DJ PROFILE . Push CREATE ON THIS XZ , or NEW PROFILE if the USB already has one. Type your DJ name on the on-screen keyboard, then push NEXT: LOGO . Pick a PNG or JPEG image from the USB, or NO LOGO . Images in your own DJPROFILE folder are listed first. Then push NEXT: TAGLINE . Type a few words, such as your genre, city or crew, and push NEXT: REVIEW . To leave the tagline out, push SKIP TAGLINE . Check the review, then push SAVE TO USB 1 or SAVE TO USB 2 . A new profile becomes the active profile on the USB you save it to. Only the DJPROFILE folder on that USB is written. Your music, playlists and stems are not touched. Step Controls Name and tagline The keyboard, SHIFT for capitals, #+= for symbols ( ABC goes back), SPACE , DELETE , BACK to the step before Logo One row per image on the USB, PREV and NEXT for more, RESCAN (or CHECK USB AGAIN ), NO LOGO , KEEP CURRENT when you edit Review CHANGE NAME , CHANGE LOGO , CHANGE TAGLINE , then SAVE TO USB 1 or SAVE TO USB 2 A name holds up to 64 characters and a tagline up to 80. With NO LOGO , your initial is shown on the accent colour. Logos are shown square over black. Nothing is saved until you push SAVE. The bottom line says NOTHING IS SAVED UNTIL YOU PRESS SAVE on the review step.
manual:20c2c0d610472848b864.text: PREV Tappa MAKE ACTIVE Aprire CONNECT › DJ PROFILE . Push CREATE ON THIS XZ o NEW PROFILE se il USB ha già uno. Inserire il nome del DJ sulla tastiera sullo schermo e quindi premere NEXT: LOGO . Scegliere un'immagine PNG o JPEG dal USB, o NO LOGO. Le immagini nella tua cartella DJPROFILE sono elencate in primo luogo. Poi premere NEXT: TAGLINE . Inserire alcune parole, come il vostro genere, città o equipaggio, e premere NEXT: REVIEW . Per lasciare il tagline, premere SKIP TAGLINE . Controlla la recensione, quindi premere SAVE TO USB 1 o SAVE TO USB 2 . Un nuovo profilo diventa il profilo attivo sul USB a cui lo salvi. Solo la cartella DJPROFILE su quella USB è scritta. La tua musica, le playlist e i tuoi stem non sono toccati. Controlli passaggi Nome e tagline La tastiera, SHIFT per i capitali, #+= per i simboli ( ABC ritorna), SPACE , DELETE , BACK al passo prima di Logo One riga per immagine sul USB, PREV e NEXT per più, RESCAN (o CHECK USB AGAIN ), NO LOGO , KEEP CURRENT quando si modifica Recensione CHANGE NAME, CHANGE LOGO , CHANGE TAGLINE , quindi SAVE TO USB 1 o SAVE TO USB 2 Un nome ha fino a 64 caratteri e una tagline fino a 80. Con NO LOGO il tuo iniziale viene visualizzato sul colore dell'accento. I logotipi sono mostrati quadrati sopra il nero. Niente è salvato fino a quando non si spinge SAVE. La linea inferiore dice NOTHING IS SAVED UNTIL YOU PRESS SAVE sulla fase di revisione.

manual:5cced1da3c9c850e24cc.source: on the top bar. Open it to see deck 3 and 4 audio render times and active key shifters across all four decks. P99 is the time at or below which 99% of the last 256 rendered blocks finished; MAX is the longest. Short blocks are scaled to a full block. D3+D4 MAX adds both maxima and compares them with the 5,805 microseconds available per block. New shifts use a stricter 3,483 microsecond budget, leaving time for other work. These render numbers include decoding, time stretch and key shift; they do not measure the complete output path. Use them when you suspect the player is working hard, for example with stems on both decks and four decks running.
manual:5cced1da3c9c850e24cc.text: sul bar superiore. Aprire per vedere deck 3 e 4 tempi di render audio e spostamenti attivi in tutti i quattro deck. P99 è il tempo in cui il 99% degli ultimi 256 blocchi renderati è finito; MAX è il più lungo. I blocchi corti sono scalati a un blocco completo. D3+D4 MAX aggiunge sia il massimo e le confronta con i 5,805 microsecondi disponibili per blocco. Nuovi cambi utilizzano un budget più rigoroso di 3,483 microseconds, lasciando tempo per altri lavori. Questi numeri di rendering includono decodifica, estensione del tempo e cambio chiave; non misurano la via di uscita completa. Utilizzate quando si sospetta che il giocatore sta lavorando duro, ad esempio con stem in entrambi i deck e quattro deck in esecuzione.

desktop:d5db97f97fc727f8fe10.source: SYNC 1 to SYNC 4: SYNC is on and follows that deck. BPM 1 to BPM 4: only the tempo follows, because QUANTIZE is off, a track has no beat grid, a loop is running, or the beat position is not available. LIMIT: the master tempo is out of reach, so the deck keeps its last tempo. EXT MASTER: a LINK player is master, which decks 3 and 4 cannot follow. NO BPM: analyse the track in your DJ software.
desktop:d5db97f97fc727f8fe10.text: SYNC 1 a SYNC 4: SYNC è in e segue quel deck. BPM 1 a BPM 4: solo il tempo segue, perché QUANTIZE è spento, una pista non ha griglia di battere, un loop è in corso o la posizione di battere non è disponibile. LIMIT: il tempo master è fuori da portata, quindi il deck mantiene il suo ultimo tempo. EXT MASTER: un giocatore LINK è master, che i deck 3 e 4 non possono seguire. NO BPM: analizzare la pista nel software DJ.

manual:2392017bed94268c937d.text: Quando metti in pausa il master, MASTER passa subito al prossimo deck in riproduzione. Ha la precedenza un deck con SYNC attivo. manual:44747ca2968b85ca6fd6.source: Four decks adds two software players, DECK 3 and DECK 4, to the XDJ-XZ's own DECK 1 and DECK 2. You hear them on mixer channels CH3 and CH4. A short USB cable from the back of the player to a top USB port carries their sound into the mixer: it leaves through a top USB port and comes back in at the rear USB socket, where a computer with DJ software would connect. The physical controls switch between decks with the same presses DJ software uses on the XDJ-XZ.
manual:44747ca2968b85ca6fd6.text: Quattro deck aggiungono due giocatori software, DECK 3 e DECK 4, ai DECK 1 e DECK 2 propri di XDJ-XZ. Li sentiamo sui canali del mixer CH3 e CH4. Un breve cavo USB dalla parte posteriore del giocatore a una porta USB top porta il suo suono nel mixer: lascia attraverso una porta USB superiore e torna al socket USB posteriore, dove un computer con software DJ si connetterebbe. Il controllo fisico interconnessione tra i deck con lo stesso software di stampa utilizza il software DJ sul XDJ-XZ.

manual:4925f473ece7eec20df8.source: The bottom channels always follow the mixer, left to right: CH3, CH1, CH2, CH4. Mixer order puts the lanes in the same order, top to bottom. Each lane and each channel carries its deck's number in a badge, so you can always tell which deck is which. Decks 1 and 2 have a white number on grey. Decks 3 and 4 have a black number on white, as on the jog displays.
manual:4925f473ece7eec20df8.text: I canali inferiori seguono sempre il mixer, a sinistra a destra: CH3, CH1, CH2, CH4. L'ordine del mixer mette le piste in un ordine, in alto in basso. Ogni pista e ogni canale porta il suo numero del deck in un segno, quindi puoi sempre dire quale deck è. Deck 1 e 2 hanno un numero bianco sul grigio. Deck 3 e 4 hanno un numero nero sul bianco, come sulle display jog.

manual:4f6bee5bbe7212fdc004.source: To connect several music sticks, put one high-speed USB 2.0 hub in the top port opposite the loopback cable. Stop or pause decks 1 and 2 while a newly connected hub starts. Connect the sticks to that hub and choose the sources the player makes available. The hub does not add more decks or source buttons.
manual:4f6bee5bbe7212fdc004.text: Per collegare diversi stick musicali, mettere un hub USB 2.0 ad alta velocità nella porta superiore contro il cavo di loopback. Stop o pausa deck 1 e 2 mentre inizia un hub appena collegato. Collegare le stick a quel hub e selezionare le fonti che il player rende disponibile. Il hub non aggiunge più deck o pulsanti sorgente.

manual:66f696237305f7717178.source: The large key in each deck's column is the key the deck plays right now. Tempo with MASTER TEMPO off, a key shift and KEY SYNC all move it. Its colour compares it with the master deck's key. Green means it mixes with the master's key: the same key, its relative major or minor, or one step away on the key wheel, tuned within 25 cents of the master. Amber means it would mix, but it is detuned by more than 25 cents. White means neither, and the master deck itself is always white. Turn KEY MATCH COLOURS off in
manual:66f696237305f7717178.text: La tonalità grande nella colonna di ogni deck è quella in cui il deck suona in questo momento. La spostano il tempo con MASTER TEMPO disattivato, uno spostamento di tonalità e KEY SYNC. Il colore la confronta con la tonalità del deck master. Verde significa che si mixa con la tonalità del master: la stessa tonalità, la relativa maggiore o minore, o un passo sulla ruota delle tonalità, accordata entro 25 centesimi dal master. Ambra significa che si mixerebbe, ma è scordata di più di 25 centesimi. Bianco significa nessuna delle due, e il deck master stesso è sempre bianco. Disattiva KEY MATCH COLOURS in

manual:680cff455983ca6918b4.source: The left column has one tag per lane. The tag of a deck a side controls is pale blue with LEFT or RIGHT. Decks 1 and 2 show the analysed key, the playing key and its cents. Decks 3 and 4 show their playing key and its cents the same way, TRACK KEY until they report it, or NOT CONNECTED and SEE THE CARD while they are not running.
manual:680cff455983ca6918b4.text: La colonna sinistra ha un tag per pista. La tag di un deck a controlli laterali è blu chiaro con LEFT o RIGHT. Deck 1 e 2 mostrano la chiave analizzata, la chiave di gioco e le sue centesimi. Deck 3 e 4 mostrano la loro chiave di giocare e le sue centimetri allo stesso modo, TRACK KEY fino a quando non lo riferiscono, o NOT CONNECTED e SEE THE CARD mentre non sono in corso.

It also records available CPU, memory, audio, SYNC, key-processing and USB-read measurements. It never records track titles, music paths, serial numbers or network identities. A missing measurement stays unknown.
manual:a82d804449cbb8d48f17.text: Il diario registra la versione XZ Mods, le impostazioni, le slot USB, l'interfaccia, la visualizzazione del deck, i cambiamenti dello stato e i codici di notifica fisse. registra anche CPU, memoria, audio, SYNC, chiave di elaborazione e misurazioni di lettura USB-lettura. Non registra mai titoli di traccia, percorsi musicali, numeri seriali o identità di rete. Una misurazione mancanza rimane sconosciuta.

Software VJ come VJ.Tools mostra il profilo del USB che sta giocando sul deck master, quindi gli schermi dietro di te mostrano chi sta giocano. Niente viene memorizzato sul XZ e nulla viene caricato.

manual:eabd4a87cc18b587a787.source: While decks 3 and 4 are not running, a four-deck view puts a card in their lanes. The card shows the cable steps, the state, and the buttons you need. Decks 1 and 2 stay live above it. In number order the card fills the lanes of decks 3 and 4 under decks 1 and 2. In mixer order it splits into a strip above deck 1 and a strip below deck 2.
manual:eabd4a87cc18b587a787.text: Mentre i deck 3 e 4 non sono in esecuzione, una vista a quattro deck mette una carta nelle loro percorsi. La carta mostra i passaggi del cavo, lo stato e i pulsanti necessari. I deck 1 e 2 rimanono viventi sopra di esso. In ordine numero la carta riempie le percorsi dei deck 3 ed 4 sotto i deck 1 ed 2. In ordine mixer si divide in una striscia sopra il deck 1 e una strisca sotto il deck 2.

manual:dcc7cfcae27bf623ed16.source: While the player records, the diary writes nothing to the stick in USB 2, where the recording goes. Each stick holds at most 4 MiB of diary files. Older segments are replaced first, and the previous session's latest segment is kept when a new session starts. Writing pauses during track loads, RAM copies and heavy USB reads. No diary is created on a read-only stick or when less than 64 MiB of free space plus a small write reserve remains. Read-only test sessions save nothing. Normal USB-loader sessions write diary entries when these conditions allow it. Long busy periods and removal can leave gaps.
manual:dcc7cfcae27bf623ed16.text: Mentre il player registra, il diario non scrive nulla sulla chiavetta in USB 2, dove va la registrazione. Ogni stick contiene un massimo di 4 MiB di file di diario. I segmenti più vecchi vengono sostituiti prima, e il segmento ultimo della sessione precedente viene mantenuto quando inizia una nuova sessione. Scrive interruzioni durante carichi di track, RAM copie e USB leggi pesanti. Nessun diario viene creato su un stick da lettura o quando meno di 64 MiB di spazio libero e una piccola riserva di scrittura rimane. Sessioni di test solo di lettura salvate nulla. Sessione di caricatura normale USB scrivere entrate di diario quando queste condizioni lo consentono. Periodi lunghi occupati e rimo possono lasciare lacune.

manual:158491ccbdf08c51113b.source: If a download is interrupted or fails verification, the app makes up to three attempts. Each attempt starts again and must pass the same size and checksum checks. If it still fails, the error distinguishes an incomplete download from a checksum mismatch. Check your connection and try again. If it continues, include that error when reporting the problem.
manual:158491ccbdf08c51113b.text: 如果下载中断或未通过验证，应用最多会尝试三次。每次尝试都会重新开始，并且必须通过相同的大小和校验和检查。如果仍然失败，错误会区分下载不完整和校验和不匹配。请检查网络连接后重试。如果问题持续，请在报告问题时附上该错误。

manual:128e0d464559fce231fb.source: In OverCue Desktop's Settings, choose the 44.1 kHz FLAC stems option. The XZ plays at 44.1 kHz, so it copies these stems straight into memory. A track's stems are ready sooner, the player does less work while it plays, and the stems take less space on the USB.
manual:128e0d464559fce231fb.text: 在 OverCue Desktop 的设置中，选择 44.1 kHz FLAC 分轨选项。XZ 以 44.1 kHz 播放，因此会把这些分轨直接复制到内存中。曲目的分轨会更快准备好，播放器在播放时的工作量更少，分轨在 USB 上占用的空间也更小。

manual:3e0dc792b8c0b7aaefe2.source: OverCue's default is 96 kHz. These stems still play, but the XZ has to convert them while it plays. That takes about a third of one processor core per deck, and they take longer to become ready. With four decks playing, they become ready more slowly than the track plays.
manual:3e0dc792b8c0b7aaefe2.text: OverCue 的默认值是 96 kHz。这类分轨仍然可以播放，但 XZ 必须在播放时对其进行转换。每个盘位大约要占用一个处理器核心三分之一的算力，分轨准备好所需的时间也更长。四个盘位同时播放时，分轨的准备速度会跟不上曲目的播放。

manual:20c2c0d610472848b864.source: PREV Tap MAKE ACTIVE Open CONNECT › DJ PROFILE . Push CREATE ON THIS XZ , or NEW PROFILE if the USB already has one. Type your DJ name on the on-screen keyboard, then push NEXT: LOGO . Pick a PNG or JPEG image from the USB, or NO LOGO . Images in your own DJPROFILE folder are listed first. Then push NEXT: TAGLINE . Type a few words, such as your genre, city or crew, and push NEXT: REVIEW . To leave the tagline out, push SKIP TAGLINE . Check the review, then push SAVE TO USB 1 or SAVE TO USB 2 . A new profile becomes the active profile on the USB you save it to. Only the DJPROFILE folder on that USB is written. Your music, playlists and stems are not touched. Step Controls Name and tagline The keyboard, SHIFT for capitals, #+= for symbols ( ABC goes back), SPACE , DELETE , BACK to the step before Logo One row per image on the USB, PREV and NEXT for more, RESCAN (or CHECK USB AGAIN ), NO LOGO , KEEP CURRENT when you edit Review CHANGE NAME , CHANGE LOGO , CHANGE TAGLINE , then SAVE TO USB 1 or SAVE TO USB 2 A name holds up to 64 characters and a tagline up to 80. With NO LOGO , your initial is shown on the accent colour. Logos are shown square over black. Nothing is saved until you push SAVE. The bottom line says NOTHING IS SAVED UNTIL YOU PRESS SAVE on the review step.
manual:20c2c0d610472848b864.text: PREV 轻触 MAKE ACTIVE 打开 CONNECT › DJ PROFILE 。按 CREATE ON THIS XZ ，如果 USB 上已有配置文件则按 NEW PROFILE。在屏幕键盘上输入你的 DJ 名称，然后按 NEXT: LOGO 。从 USB 选择一张 PNG 或 JPEG 图片，或选择 NO LOGO 。你自己的 DJPROFILE 文件夹中的图片排在最前面。然后按 NEXT: TAGLINE 。输入几个词，例如你的曲风、城市或团队，然后按 NEXT: REVIEW 。如果不要标语，按 SKIP TAGLINE 。检查确认页，然后按 SAVE TO USB 1 或 SAVE TO USB 2 。新配置文件会成为你所保存到的 USB 上的当前配置文件。只会写入该 USB 上的 DJPROFILE 文件夹。你的音乐、播放列表和分轨都不会被改动。步骤 控件 名称和标语 键盘，SHIFT 输入大写，#+= 输入符号（ ABC 返回），SPACE ，DELETE ，BACK 返回上一步 标志 USB 上每张图片一行，PREV 和 NEXT 查看更多，RESCAN （或 CHECK USB AGAIN ），NO LOGO ，编辑时 KEEP CURRENT 确认 CHANGE NAME ，CHANGE LOGO ，CHANGE TAGLINE ，然后 SAVE TO USB 1 或 SAVE TO USB 2 名称最多 64 个字符，标语最多 80 个字符。使用 NO LOGO 时，你的首字母显示在强调色上。标志以方形显示在黑色背景上。在你按下 SAVE 之前不会保存任何内容。在确认步骤中，底行显示 NOTHING IS SAVED UNTIL YOU PRESS SAVE。

manual:5cced1da3c9c850e24cc.source: on the top bar. Open it to see deck 3 and 4 audio render times and active key shifters across all four decks. P99 is the time at or below which 99% of the last 256 rendered blocks finished; MAX is the longest. Short blocks are scaled to a full block. D3+D4 MAX adds both maxima and compares them with the 5,805 microseconds available per block. New shifts use a stricter 3,483 microsecond budget, leaving time for other work. These render numbers include decoding, time stretch and key shift; they do not measure the complete output path. Use them when you suspect the player is working hard, for example with stems on both decks and four decks running.
manual:5cced1da3c9c850e24cc.text: 在顶部栏上打开它,以查看盘位3和4音频播放时间和所有四个盘位的活跃关键转换时间。P99是最后的256播放区块完成的 99% 的时间或以下; MAX是最长的。短的区块将扩展到一个完整的区块。D3+D4 MAX增加了两种最大,并将它们与每区块可用的5,805微秒比较。新转换使用更严格的预算,留下时间其他工作。这些转换数字包括解码、时间延伸和关键转换;它们不测量完整的输出路径。当你怀疑玩家正在努力工作,例如在盘位和四个盘位上运行分轨时使用它们。

desktop:d5db97f97fc727f8fe10.source: SYNC 1 to SYNC 4: SYNC is on and follows that deck. BPM 1 to BPM 4: only the tempo follows, because QUANTIZE is off, a track has no beat grid, a loop is running, or the beat position is not available. LIMIT: the master tempo is out of reach, so the deck keeps its last tempo. EXT MASTER: a LINK player is master, which decks 3 and 4 cannot follow. NO BPM: analyse the track in your DJ software.
desktop:d5db97f97fc727f8fe10.text: SYNC 1 到 SYNC 4: SYNC 是活跃的,并跟随那个盘位。 BPM 1 到 BPM 4:只有速度,因为 QUANTIZE 是关闭的,轨道没有打网,路径正在运行,或者打位置不可用。 LIMIT:主节奏是无法达到的,所以盘位保持其最后的速度。 EXT MASTER: LINK 玩家是主,而盘位3 和 4 无法跟随的。 NO BPM:分析你的 DJ 软件中的轨道。

Edit it in VJ.Tools, or make a new profile Your active profile also sits in the MODS header, with its logo and name. Tap it, or highlight it and push, to switch between the profiles on both USBs. manual:2392017bed94268c937d.source: When you pause the master, MASTER passes at once to the next playing deck. A deck with SYNC on comes first. manual:44747ca2968b85ca6fd6.source: Four decks adds two software players, DECK 3 and DECK 4, to the XDJ-XZ's own DECK 1 and DECK 2. You hear them on mixer channels CH3 and CH4. A short USB cable from the back of the player to a top USB port carries their sound into the mixer: it leaves through a top USB port and comes back in at the rear USB socket, where a computer with DJ software would connect. The physical controls switch between decks with the same presses DJ software uses on the XDJ-XZ.
manual:44747ca2968b85ca6fd6.text: 四个盘位将两个软件玩家,DECK 3和DECK 4添加到XDJ-XZ的DECK 1和DECK 2。您可以在混合频道CH3和CH4中听到它们。一个短的USB电缆从玩家背部到顶部USB端口将其音量传入混合器中:它通过顶部USB端口,回到后面的USB接口,其中一个具有DJ软件的计算机会连接。物理控制器在盘位之间切换与相同的印刷DJ软件在XDJ-XZ上使用。

manual:4925f473ece7eec20df8.source: The bottom channels always follow the mixer, left to right: CH3, CH1, CH2, CH4. Mixer order puts the lanes in the same order, top to bottom. Each lane and each channel carries its deck's number in a badge, so you can always tell which deck is which. Decks 1 and 2 have a white number on grey. Decks 3 and 4 have a black number on white, as on the jog displays.
manual:4925f473ece7eec20df8.text: 底线频道总是跟着混合器,左向右: CH3, CH1, CH2, CH4.混合器订单将路径放在同一顺序,顶向下。每条线路和每条线条都携带其盘位号码在标志上,所以你总是可以说哪个盘位。 1和 2 盘位有灰色白色号码。 3 和 4 盘位有黑色号码,如在游行显示器上。

manual:66f696237305f7717178.source: The large key in each deck's column is the key the deck plays right now. Tempo with MASTER TEMPO off, a key shift and KEY SYNC all move it. Its colour compares it with the master deck's key. Green means it mixes with the master's key: the same key, its relative major or minor, or one step away on the key wheel, tuned within 25 cents of the master. Amber means it would mix, but it is detuned by more than 25 cents. White means neither, and the master deck itself is always white. Turn KEY MATCH COLOURS off in
manual:66f696237305f7717178.text: 每个盘位列中的主要关键是盘位目前正在发挥的关键。速度,MASTER TEMPO关闭,一个关键转换和KEY SYNC所有移动它。它的颜色与主人盘位的钥匙相比。绿色意味着它与主人的钥匙混合:相同的钥匙,其相对大或小,或在主人的25美分之内调节一个步骤。阿姆伯意味着它会混合,但它被超过25美分分解。白色并不意味着,主人盘位本身总是白色的。第KEY MATCH COLOURS章 关闭

manual:e6cccc4ccf08f26a2838.source: Four channels in mixer order 3 1 2 4. Each shows the deck's title, time, QUANTIZE, tempo and range, AUTO CUE and MT, what SYNC follows, what the pads do, the BPM (orange with MASTER for the master deck) and the whole-track overview. A deck that is not connected shows a dim band with NOT CONNECTED and DECK n WAITS FOR THE LOOPBACK CABLE.
manual:e6cccc4ccf08f26a2838.text: 按调音台顺序 3 1 2 4 排列的四个通道。每个通道显示盘位的标题、时间、QUANTIZE、速度和范围、AUTO CUE 和 MT、SYNC 跟随的对象、打击垫的作用、BPM（主控盘位为橙色并带 MASTER）以及整首曲目的概览。未连接的盘位显示一条暗色带，带有 NOT CONNECTED 和 DECK n WAITS FOR THE LOOPBACK CABLE。

manual:dcc7cfcae27bf623ed16.source: While the player records, the diary writes nothing to the stick in USB 2, where the recording goes. Each stick holds at most 4 MiB of diary files. Older segments are replaced first, and the previous session's latest segment is kept when a new session starts. Writing pauses during track loads, RAM copies and heavy USB reads. No diary is created on a read-only stick or when less than 64 MiB of free space plus a small write reserve remains. Read-only test sessions save nothing. Normal USB-loader sessions write diary entries when these conditions allow it. Long busy periods and removal can leave gaps.
manual:dcc7cfcae27bf623ed16.text: 播放器录音时，日志不会向 USB 2 中的 U 盘（录音保存的位置）写入任何内容。每条插件大多包含4MB日记文件。较早的部分首先更换,在新会议开始时,前次会议的最新部分保持。, RAM 副本和重量 USB 阅读:没有日记在只读的笔记本上创建或在少于64MB的自由空间以及小写储备时,没有日记。 USB-载荷会话写日记输入,当这些条件允许时。 长时间繁忙和删除可能会留下空洞.

manual:128e0d464559fce231fb.source: In OverCue Desktop's Settings, choose the 44.1 kHz FLAC stems option. The XZ plays at 44.1 kHz, so it copies these stems straight into memory. A track's stems are ready sooner, the player does less work while it plays, and the stems take less space on the USB.
manual:128e0d464559fce231fb.text: 在 OverCue Desktop 的設定中，選擇 44.1 kHz FLAC 分軌選項。XZ 以 44.1 kHz 播放，因此會把這些分軌直接複製到記憶體中。曲目的分軌會更快準備好，播放器在播放時的工作量更少，分軌在 USB 上佔用的空間也更小。

manual:3e0dc792b8c0b7aaefe2.source: OverCue's default is 96 kHz. These stems still play, but the XZ has to convert them while it plays. That takes about a third of one processor core per deck, and they take longer to become ready. With four decks playing, they become ready more slowly than the track plays.
manual:3e0dc792b8c0b7aaefe2.text: OverCue 的預設值是 96 kHz。這類分軌仍然可以播放，但 XZ 必須在播放時進行轉換。每個盤位大約要佔用一個處理器核心三分之一的運算能力，分軌準備好所需的時間也更長。四個盤位同時播放時，分軌的準備速度會跟不上曲目的播放。

manual:20c2c0d610472848b864.source: PREV Tap MAKE ACTIVE Open CONNECT › DJ PROFILE . Push CREATE ON THIS XZ , or NEW PROFILE if the USB already has one. Type your DJ name on the on-screen keyboard, then push NEXT: LOGO . Pick a PNG or JPEG image from the USB, or NO LOGO . Images in your own DJPROFILE folder are listed first. Then push NEXT: TAGLINE . Type a few words, such as your genre, city or crew, and push NEXT: REVIEW . To leave the tagline out, push SKIP TAGLINE . Check the review, then push SAVE TO USB 1 or SAVE TO USB 2 . A new profile becomes the active profile on the USB you save it to. Only the DJPROFILE folder on that USB is written. Your music, playlists and stems are not touched. Step Controls Name and tagline The keyboard, SHIFT for capitals, #+= for symbols ( ABC goes back), SPACE , DELETE , BACK to the step before Logo One row per image on the USB, PREV and NEXT for more, RESCAN (or CHECK USB AGAIN ), NO LOGO , KEEP CURRENT when you edit Review CHANGE NAME , CHANGE LOGO , CHANGE TAGLINE , then SAVE TO USB 1 or SAVE TO USB 2 A name holds up to 64 characters and a tagline up to 80. With NO LOGO , your initial is shown on the accent colour. Logos are shown square over black. Nothing is saved until you push SAVE. The bottom line says NOTHING IS SAVED UNTIL YOU PRESS SAVE on the review step.
manual:20c2c0d610472848b864.text: PREV 輕觸 MAKE ACTIVE 打開 CONNECT › DJ PROFILE 。按 CREATE ON THIS XZ ，如果 USB 上已有配置文件則按 NEW PROFILE。在屏幕鍵盤上輸入你的 DJ 名稱，然後按 NEXT: LOGO 。從 USB 選擇一張 PNG 或 JPEG 圖片，或選擇 NO LOGO 。你自己的 DJPROFILE 文件夾中的圖片排在最前面。然後按 NEXT: TAGLINE 。輸入幾個詞，例如你的曲風、城市或團隊，然後按 NEXT: REVIEW 。如果不要標語，按 SKIP TAGLINE 。檢查確認頁，然後按 SAVE TO USB 1 或 SAVE TO USB 2 。新配置文件會成爲你所保存到的 USB 上的當前配置文件。只會寫入該 USB 上的 DJPROFILE 文件夾。你的音樂、播放列表和分軌都不會被改動。步驟 控件 名稱和標語 鍵盤，SHIFT 輸入大寫，#+= 輸入符號（ ABC 返回），SPACE ，DELETE ，BACK 返回上一步 標誌 USB 上每張圖片一行，PREV 和 NEXT 查看更多，RESCAN （或 CHECK USB AGAIN ），NO LOGO ，編輯時 KEEP CURRENT 確認 CHANGE NAME ，CHANGE LOGO ，CHANGE TAGLINE ，然後 SAVE TO USB 1 或 SAVE TO USB 2 名稱最多 64 個字符，標語最多 80 個字符。使用 NO LOGO 時，你的首字母顯示在強調色上。標誌以方形顯示在黑色背景上。在你按下 SAVE 之前不會保存任何內容。在確認步驟中，底行顯示 NOTHING IS SAVED UNTIL YOU PRESS SAVE。

manual:5cced1da3c9c850e24cc.source: on the top bar. Open it to see deck 3 and 4 audio render times and active key shifters across all four decks. P99 is the time at or below which 99% of the last 256 rendered blocks finished; MAX is the longest. Short blocks are scaled to a full block. D3+D4 MAX adds both maxima and compares them with the 5,805 microseconds available per block. New shifts use a stricter 3,483 microsecond budget, leaving time for other work. These render numbers include decoding, time stretch and key shift; they do not measure the complete output path. Use them when you suspect the player is working hard, for example with stems on both decks and four decks running.
manual:5cced1da3c9c850e24cc.text: 在頂部欄上打開它,以查看盤位3和4音頻播放時間和所有四個盤位的活躍關鍵轉換時間。P99是最後的256播放區塊完成的 99% 的時間或以下; MAX是最長的。短的區塊將擴展到一個完整的區塊。D3+D4 MAX增加了兩種最大,並將它們與每區塊可用的5,805微秒比較。新轉換使用更嚴格的預算,留下時間其他工作。這些轉換數字包括解碼、時間延伸和關鍵轉換;它們不測量完整的輸出路徑。當你懷疑玩家正在努力工作,例如在盤位和四個盤位上運行分軌時使用它們。

desktop:d5db97f97fc727f8fe10.source: SYNC 1 to SYNC 4: SYNC is on and follows that deck. BPM 1 to BPM 4: only the tempo follows, because QUANTIZE is off, a track has no beat grid, a loop is running, or the beat position is not available. LIMIT: the master tempo is out of reach, so the deck keeps its last tempo. EXT MASTER: a LINK player is master, which decks 3 and 4 cannot follow. NO BPM: analyse the track in your DJ software.
desktop:d5db97f97fc727f8fe10.text: SYNC 1 到 SYNC 4: SYNC 是活躍的,並跟隨那個盤位。 BPM 1 到 BPM 4:只有速度,因爲 QUANTIZE 是關閉的,軌道沒有打網,路徑正在運行,或者打位置不可用。 LIMIT:主節奏是無法達到的,所以盤位保持其最後的速度。 EXT MASTER: LINK 玩家是主,而盤位3 和 4 無法跟隨的。 NO BPM:分析你的 DJ 軟件中的軌道。

manual:086e326b6e5d41258b81.source: PREV , NEXT > Step through the profiles on both USBs. 2 OF 3 shows where you are EDIT Change this profile's name, logo or tagline MAKE ACTIVE Makes this the active profile on its USB. Only the USB is written NEW PROFILE Makes another profile on the USB, for an alias or a back to back set CHECK USB Reads both USB ports again ACTIVE ON THIS USB This profile is the one its USB says is playing SHOWN TO THE VJ NOW This is the profile VJ software sees right now FROM ITS FOLDER IN DJPROFILE A profile made from a folder and a logo OLDER CARD: EDIT IT IN VJ.TOOLS An older profile card. Edit it in VJ.Tools, or make a new profile Your active profile also sits in the MODS header, with its logo and name. Tap it, or highlight it and push, to switch between the profiles on both USBs. Note The player's own saved settings are MY SETTINGS in UTILITY. They are separate from your DJ profile.
manual:086e326b6e5d41258b81.text: PREV , NEXT > 通過兩者 USBs 的個人資料步驟。2 OF 3 顯示您所在地 EDIT 更改該個人資料的名稱、標誌或標籤 MAKE ACTIVE 使此成爲其 USB 活躍的個人資料。只有 USB 寫的 NEW PROFILE 在 USB 創建另一個個人資料,以標誌或回覆設置 CHECK USB 讀了兩者 USB 端口再次 ACTIVE ON THIS USB 這個個人資料是 USB 說它正在播放 SHOWN TO THE VJ NOW 這是該個人資料 VJ 軟件現在看到 FROM ITS FOLDER IN DJPROFILE 個個人資料由文件夾和標誌 OLDER CARD: EDIT IT IN VJ.TOOLS 一箇舊的個人資料卡。編輯在 VJ.Tools 中,或者創建一個新的個人資料 您的活躍個人資料也在MODS標題中,其標誌和名字。點擊它,或者突出它並按下,切換兩個USBs的個人資料之間。注意 玩家自己的保存設置是 MY SETTINGS 在 UTILITY 中。它們與你的DJ個人資料分開。

manual:2392017bed94268c937d.source: When you pause the master, MASTER passes at once to the next playing deck. A deck with SYNC on comes first. Otherwise after deck 3 comes deck 4, then decks 1 and 2. After deck 4 come decks 1 and 2, then deck 3. In VINYL mode MASTER passes when you press pause, while the deck slows down.
manual:2392017bed94268c937d.text: 當您休息主人時, MASTER 立即進入下一個遊戲盤位。 一個有 SYNC 的盤位首先到來。 否則,在盤位 3 後到達盤位 4,然後到達盤位 1 後到盤位 2 後,盤位 3 時到達盤位 3 。 在 VINYL 模式下, MASTER 通過,當您按住休息時,盤位放緩。

manual:44747ca2968b85ca6fd6.source: Four decks adds two software players, DECK 3 and DECK 4, to the XDJ-XZ's own DECK 1 and DECK 2. You hear them on mixer channels CH3 and CH4. A short USB cable from the back of the player to a top USB port carries their sound into the mixer: it leaves through a top USB port and comes back in at the rear USB socket, where a computer with DJ software would connect. The physical controls switch between decks with the same presses DJ software uses on the XDJ-XZ.
manual:44747ca2968b85ca6fd6.text: 四個盤位將兩個軟件玩家,DECK 3和DECK 4添加到XDJ-XZ的DECK 1和DECK 2。您可以在混合頻道CH3和CH4中聽到它們。一個短的USB電纜從玩家背部到頂部USB端口將其音量傳入混合器中:它通過頂部USB端口,回到後面的USB接口,其中一個具有DJ軟件的計算機會連接。物理控制器在盤位之間切換與相同的印刷DJ軟件在XDJ-XZ上使用。

manual:4925f473ece7eec20df8.source: The bottom channels always follow the mixer, left to right: CH3, CH1, CH2, CH4. Mixer order puts the lanes in the same order, top to bottom. Each lane and each channel carries its deck's number in a badge, so you can always tell which deck is which. Decks 1 and 2 have a white number on grey. Decks 3 and 4 have a black number on white, as on the jog displays.
manual:4925f473ece7eec20df8.text: 底線頻道總是跟着混合器,左向右: CH3, CH1, CH2, CH4.混合器訂單將路徑放在同一順序,頂向下。每條線路和每條線條都攜帶其盤位號碼在標誌上,所以你總是可以說哪個盤位。 1和 2 盤位有灰色白色號碼。 3 和 4 盤位有黑色號碼,如在遊行顯示器上。

manual:66f696237305f7717178.source: The large key in each deck's column is the key the deck plays right now. Tempo with MASTER TEMPO off, a key shift and KEY SYNC all move it. Its colour compares it with the master deck's key. Green means it mixes with the master's key: the same key, its relative major or minor, or one step away on the key wheel, tuned within 25 cents of the master. Amber means it would mix, but it is detuned by more than 25 cents. White means neither, and the master deck itself is always white. Turn KEY MATCH COLOURS off in
manual:66f696237305f7717178.text: 每個盤位列中的主要關鍵是盤位目前正在發揮的關鍵。速度,MASTER TEMPO關閉,一個關鍵轉換和KEY SYNC所有移動它。它的顏色與主人盤位的鑰匙相比。綠色意味着它與主人的鑰匙混合:相同的鑰匙,其相對大或小,或在主人的25美分之內調節一個步驟。阿姆伯意味着它會混合,但它被超過25美分分解。白色並不意味着,主人盤位本身總是白色的。第KEY MATCH COLOURS章 關閉

manual:eabd4a87cc18b587a787.source: While decks 3 and 4 are not running, a four-deck view puts a card in their lanes. The card shows the cable steps, the state, and the buttons you need. Decks 1 and 2 stay live above it. In number order the card fills the lanes of decks 3 and 4 under decks 1 and 2. In mixer order it splits into a strip above deck 1 and a strip below deck 2.
manual:eabd4a87cc18b587a787.text: 雖然3和4個盤位沒有運行,但四個盤位景色將卡放在他們的路線上。卡片顯示您需要的電纜步驟、狀態和按鈕。盤位1和2住在那裏。按號碼,卡片填滿了盤位1和2下的盤位3和4的路徑。在混合器順序,它分爲盤位1上一帶,盤位2下一帶。

manual:dcc7cfcae27bf623ed16.source: While the player records, the diary writes nothing to the stick in USB 2, where the recording goes. Each stick holds at most 4 MiB of diary files. Older segments are replaced first, and the previous session's latest segment is kept when a new session starts. Writing pauses during track loads, RAM copies and heavy USB reads. No diary is created on a read-only stick or when less than 64 MiB of free space plus a small write reserve remains. Read-only test sessions save nothing. Normal USB-loader sessions write diary entries when these conditions allow it. Long busy periods and removal can leave gaps.
manual:dcc7cfcae27bf623ed16.text: 播放器錄音時，日誌不會向 USB 2 中的隨身碟（錄音儲存的位置）寫入任何內容。每條插件大多包含4MB日記文件。較早的部分首先更換,在新會議開始時,前次會議的最新部分保持。, RAM 副本和重量 USB 閱讀:沒有日記在只讀的筆記本上創建或在少於64MB的自由空間以及小寫儲備時,沒有日記。 USB-載荷會話寫日記輸入,當這些條件允許時。 長時間繁忙和刪除可能會留下空洞.

manual:158491ccbdf08c51113b.source: If a download is interrupted or fails verification, the app makes up to three attempts. Each attempt starts again and must pass the same size and checksum checks. If it still fails, the error distinguishes an incomplete download from a checksum mismatch. Check your connection and try again. If it continues, include that error when reporting the problem.
manual:158491ccbdf08c51113b.text: Als een download wordt onderbroken of de controle niet doorstaat, probeert de app het tot drie keer. Elke poging begint opnieuw en moet dezelfde controles op grootte en checksum doorstaan. Mislukt het dan nog, dan maakt de foutmelding onderscheid tussen een onvolledige download en een checksum die niet klopt. Controleer uw verbinding en probeer het opnieuw. Blijft het gebeuren, vermeld die fout dan bij het melden van het probleem.

manual:128e0d464559fce231fb.source: In OverCue Desktop's Settings, choose the 44.1 kHz FLAC stems option. The XZ plays at 44.1 kHz, so it copies these stems straight into memory. A track's stems are ready sooner, the player does less work while it plays, and the stems take less space on the USB.
manual:128e0d464559fce231fb.text: Kies in de Instellingen van OverCue Desktop de optie voor stems in 44.1 kHz FLAC. De XZ speelt af op 44.1 kHz en kopieert deze stems daarom rechtstreeks naar het geheugen. De stems van een track zijn sneller klaar, de speler hoeft minder werk te doen tijdens het afspelen en de stems nemen minder ruimte in op de USB.

manual:3e0dc792b8c0b7aaefe2.source: OverCue's default is 96 kHz. These stems still play, but the XZ has to convert them while it plays. That takes about a third of one processor core per deck, and they take longer to become ready. With four decks playing, they become ready more slowly than the track plays.
manual:3e0dc792b8c0b7aaefe2.text: De standaard van OverCue is 96 kHz. Deze stems spelen nog steeds af, maar de XZ moet ze tijdens het afspelen omzetten. Dat kost ongeveer een derde van één processorkern per deck, en het duurt langer voordat de stems klaar zijn. Met vier spelende decks worden ze langzamer klaargemaakt dan de track afspeelt.

manual:20c2c0d610472848b864.source: PREV Tap MAKE ACTIVE Open CONNECT › DJ PROFILE . Push CREATE ON THIS XZ , or NEW PROFILE if the USB already has one. Type your DJ name on the on-screen keyboard, then push NEXT: LOGO . Pick a PNG or JPEG image from the USB, or NO LOGO . Images in your own DJPROFILE folder are listed first. Then push NEXT: TAGLINE . Type a few words, such as your genre, city or crew, and push NEXT: REVIEW . To leave the tagline out, push SKIP TAGLINE . Check the review, then push SAVE TO USB 1 or SAVE TO USB 2 . A new profile becomes the active profile on the USB you save it to. Only the DJPROFILE folder on that USB is written. Your music, playlists and stems are not touched. Step Controls Name and tagline The keyboard, SHIFT for capitals, #+= for symbols ( ABC goes back), SPACE , DELETE , BACK to the step before Logo One row per image on the USB, PREV and NEXT for more, RESCAN (or CHECK USB AGAIN ), NO LOGO , KEEP CURRENT when you edit Review CHANGE NAME , CHANGE LOGO , CHANGE TAGLINE , then SAVE TO USB 1 or SAVE TO USB 2 A name holds up to 64 characters and a tagline up to 80. With NO LOGO , your initial is shown on the accent colour. Logos are shown square over black. Nothing is saved until you push SAVE. The bottom line says NOTHING IS SAVED UNTIL YOU PRESS SAVE on the review step.
manual:20c2c0d610472848b864.text: PREV Tik op MAKE ACTIVE Open CONNECT › DJ PROFILE . Druk op CREATE ON THIS XZ , of op NEW PROFILE als de USB er al een heeft. Typ je DJ-naam op het schermtoetsenbord en druk dan op NEXT: LOGO . Kies een PNG- of JPEG-afbeelding van de USB, of NO LOGO . Afbeeldingen in je eigen DJPROFILE-map staan bovenaan. Druk daarna op NEXT: TAGLINE . Typ een paar woorden, zoals je genre, stad of crew, en druk op NEXT: REVIEW . Wil je geen tagline, druk dan op SKIP TAGLINE . Controleer het overzicht en druk dan op SAVE TO USB 1 of SAVE TO USB 2 . Een nieuw profiel wordt het actieve profiel op de USB waarop je het opslaat. Alleen de DJPROFILE-map op die USB wordt beschreven. Je muziek, afspeellijsten en stems blijven onaangeroerd. Stap Bediening Naam en tagline Het toetsenbord, SHIFT voor hoofdletters, #+= voor symbolen ( ABC gaat terug), SPACE , DELETE , BACK naar de vorige stap Logo Eén rij per afbeelding op de USB, PREV en NEXT voor meer, RESCAN (of CHECK USB AGAIN ), NO LOGO , KEEP CURRENT bij bewerken Overzicht CHANGE NAME , CHANGE LOGO , CHANGE TAGLINE , dan SAVE TO USB 1 of SAVE TO USB 2 Een naam bevat tot 64 tekens en een tagline tot 80. Met NO LOGO wordt je beginletter op de accentkleur getoond. Logo’s worden vierkant op zwart getoond. Er wordt niets opgeslagen tot je op SAVE drukt. De onderste regel toont bij de overzichtsstap NOTHING IS SAVED UNTIL YOU PRESS SAVE.

manual:5cced1da3c9c850e24cc.source: on the top bar. Open it to see deck 3 and 4 audio render times and active key shifters across all four decks. P99 is the time at or below which 99% of the last 256 rendered blocks finished; MAX is the longest. Short blocks are scaled to a full block. D3+D4 MAX adds both maxima and compares them with the 5,805 microseconds available per block. New shifts use a stricter 3,483 microsecond budget, leaving time for other work. These render numbers include decoding, time stretch and key shift; they do not measure the complete output path. Use them when you suspect the player is working hard, for example with stems on both decks and four decks running.
manual:5cced1da3c9c850e24cc.text: op de topbar. Open het om deck 3 en 4 audio rendertijden en actieve sleutelschifters in alle vier decks te zien. P99 is de tijd waarop 99% van de laatste 256 rendered blokken zijn voltooid; MAX is de langste. Korte blokken worden uitgesteld tot een volledige blok. D3+D4 MAX voegt beide maxima toe en vergelijkt ze met de 5,805 microseconden beschikbaar per blok. Nieuwe schiften gebruiken een strenger 3.483 microsecond budget, waardoor tijd voor andere werk. Deze rendering cijfers omvatten decoding, tijdstreek en sleutelschijf; ze meeten niet de volledige uitgangspath. Gebruik ze wanneer je vermoedt dat de speler hard werkt, bijvoorbeeld met stems op beide decks en vier decks lopen.

desktop:d5db97f97fc727f8fe10.source: SYNC 1 to SYNC 4: SYNC is on and follows that deck. BPM 1 to BPM 4: only the tempo follows, because QUANTIZE is off, a track has no beat grid, a loop is running, or the beat position is not available. LIMIT: the master tempo is out of reach, so the deck keeps its last tempo. EXT MASTER: a LINK player is master, which decks 3 and 4 cannot follow. NO BPM: analyse the track in your DJ software.
desktop:d5db97f97fc727f8fe10.text: SYNC 1 tot SYNC 4: SYNC is op en volgt dat deck. BPM 1 tot BPM 4: alleen het tempo volgt, omdat QUANTIZE is afgeschakeld, een track heeft geen beatnet, een loop is lopen of de beatpositie is niet beschikbaar. LIMIT: het master tempo is niet bereikbaar, dus het deck houdt zijn laatste tempo. EXT MASTER: een LINK-speler is master, die decks 3 en 4 niet kunnen volgen. NO BPM: analyse het track in uw DJ-software.

manual:086e326b6e5d41258b81.source: PREV , NEXT > Step through the profiles on both USBs. 2 OF 3 shows where you are EDIT Change this profile's name, logo or tagline MAKE ACTIVE Makes this the active profile on its USB. Only the USB is written NEW PROFILE Makes another profile on the USB, for an alias or a back to back set CHECK USB Reads both USB ports again ACTIVE ON THIS USB This profile is the one its USB says is playing SHOWN TO THE VJ NOW This is the profile VJ software sees right now FROM ITS FOLDER IN DJPROFILE A profile made from a folder and a logo OLDER CARD: EDIT IT IN VJ.TOOLS An older profile card. Edit it in VJ.Tools, or make a new profile Your active profile also sits in the MODS header, with its logo and name. Tap it, or highlight it and push, to switch between the profiles on both USBs. Note The player's own saved settings are MY SETTINGS in UTILITY. They are separate from your DJ profile.
manual:086e326b6e5d41258b81.text: PREV , NEXT > Stap door de profielen op beide USBs. 2 OF 3 toont waar je bent EDIT Verander de naam van dit profiel, logo of tagline MAKE ACTIVE maakt dit het actieve profiel op zijn USB. Alleen de USB wordt geschreven NEW PROFILE maakt een ander profiel op de USB, voor een alias of een achteruit set CHECK USB Lees beide USB poorten weer ACTIVE ON THIS USB Dit profiel is het zijn USB zegt speelt SHOWN TO THE VJ NOW Dit is het profiel VJ software ziet nu FROM ITS FOLDER IN DJPROFILE Een profiel gemaakt van een map en een logo OLDER CARD: EDIT IT IN VJ.TOOLS Een oudere profielkaart. Bewerken het in VJ.Tools, of maak een nieuw profiel Uw actief profiel zit ook in het MODS-hoofd, met zijn logo en naam. Tik het, of benadruk het en druk, om tussen de profielen in beide USBs. Merk op de eigen opgeslagen instellingen van de speler zijn MY SETTINGS in UTILITY. Ze zijn gescheiden van uw DJ-profiel.

manual:44747ca2968b85ca6fd6.source: Four decks adds two software players, DECK 3 and DECK 4, to the XDJ-XZ's own DECK 1 and DECK 2. You hear them on mixer channels CH3 and CH4. A short USB cable from the back of the player to a top USB port carries their sound into the mixer: it leaves through a top USB port and comes back in at the rear USB socket, where a computer with DJ software would connect. The physical controls switch between decks with the same presses DJ software uses on the XDJ-XZ.
manual:44747ca2968b85ca6fd6.text: Vier decks voegen twee softwarespeler, DECK 3 en DECK 4, toe aan de XDJ-XZ's eigen DECK 1 en DECK 2. Je hoort ze op de mixerkanalen CH3 en CH4. Een korte USB kabel van de achterkant van de speler naar een top USB poort brengt hun geluid in de mixer: het verlaat door een top USB poort en komt terug in aan de achterkant USB socket, waar een computer met DJ-software zou verbinden. De fysieke controles schakelen tussen decks met dezelfde druk DJ-softwaren gebruikt op de XDJ-XZ.

manual:4925f473ece7eec20df8.text: De onderkanalen volgen altijd de mixer, links naar rechts: CH3, CH1, CH2, CH4. De mixer-order zet de paden in dezelfde volgorde, boven naar beneden. Elke lijn en elk kanaal draagt zijn decknummer in een badge, zodat je altijd kunt zeggen welk deck het is. Decks 1 en 2 hebben een wit nummer op grijs. Decks 3 en 4 hebben een zwart nummer op wit, zoals op de jogscherm.

manual:62a43847aca915aa72a9.source: Turn the side while the deck plays to bend its speed. The faster you turn, the more it bends, so a gentle nudge moves it only a little. With VINYL on, scratch on the platter top. For a backspin, spin the platter and let go: the deck follows the platter until it stops, then plays on.
manual:62a43847aca915aa72a9.text: Draai aan de zijkant terwijl het deck speelt om de snelheid te buigen. Hoe sneller je draait, hoe meer het buigt, dus een zacht duwtje verplaatst het maar een beetje. Met VINYL aan scratch je op de bovenkant van de jogwheel. Voor een backspin draai je de jogwheel en laat je los: het deck volgt de jogwheel tot die stopt en speelt dan verder.

manual:66f696237305f7717178.source: The large key in each deck's column is the key the deck plays right now. Tempo with MASTER TEMPO off, a key shift and KEY SYNC all move it. Its colour compares it with the master deck's key. Green means it mixes with the master's key: the same key, its relative major or minor, or one step away on the key wheel, tuned within 25 cents of the master. Amber means it would mix, but it is detuned by more than 25 cents. White means neither, and the master deck itself is always white. Turn KEY MATCH COLOURS off in
manual:66f696237305f7717178.text: De grote sleutel in elke deckkolom is de sleutel die het deck momenteel speelt. Tempo met MASTER TEMPO af, een sleutelschakeling en KEY SYNC alles bewegt het. De kleur vergelijkt het met de sleutel van het masterdeck. Groen betekent dat het gemengt met de sleutels van de master: dezelfde sleutel, zijn relatieve grote of minder, of een stap weg op het sleutelwiel, die binnen 25 cent van de master is aangepakt. Amber betekent dat het zou mengen, maar het wordt gedetecteerd door meer dan 25 cent. Wit betekent niet, en het masterdeck zelf is altijd wit. Draai KEY MATCH COLOURS uit in

Een deck dat niet is verbonden toont een dim band met NOT CONNECTED en DECK n WAITS FOR THE LOOPBACK CABLE.

manual:dcc7cfcae27bf623ed16.source: While the player records, the diary writes nothing to the stick in USB 2, where the recording goes. Each stick holds at most 4 MiB of diary files. Older segments are replaced first, and the previous session's latest segment is kept when a new session starts. Writing pauses during track loads, RAM copies and heavy USB reads. No diary is created on a read-only stick or when less than 64 MiB of free space plus a small write reserve remains. Read-only test sessions save nothing. Normal USB-loader sessions write diary entries when these conditions allow it. Long busy periods and removal can leave gaps.
manual:dcc7cfcae27bf623ed16.text: Terwijl de speler opneemt, schrijft het dagboek niets naar de stick in USB 2, waar de opname naartoe gaat. Elke stick bevat maximaal 4 MiB dagboekbestanden. Oudere segmenten worden eerst vervangen en het laatste segment van de vorige sessie wordt bewaard wanneer een nieuwe sessie begint. Schrijf pauze tijdens trackloads, RAM kopieën en zware USB lezen. Geen dagboek wordt gemaakt op een alleen lees-stick of wanneer minder dan 64 MiB vrije ruimte plus een klein schrijfreserve blijft. Lees-only test sessieën bespaart niets. Normale USB-loader sessie schrijf dagboekopnamen wanneer deze omstandigheden toestaan. Lang drukke periodes en verwijdering kunnen gaten achterlaten.

manual:128e0d464559fce231fb.source: In OverCue Desktop's Settings, choose the 44.1 kHz FLAC stems option. The XZ plays at 44.1 kHz, so it copies these stems straight into memory. A track's stems are ready sooner, the player does less work while it plays, and the stems take less space on the USB.

Bir parçanın stem'leri daha erken hazır olur, çalar çalma sırasında daha az iş yapar ve stem'ler USB'de daha az yer kaplar.

manual:3e0dc792b8c0b7aaefe2.source: OverCue's default is 96 kHz. These stems still play, but the XZ has to convert them while it plays. That takes about a third of one processor core per deck, and they take longer to become ready. With four decks playing, they become ready more slowly than the track plays.
manual:3e0dc792b8c0b7aaefe2.text: OverCue'nun varsayılanı 96 kHz'dir. Bu stem'ler yine de çalınır, ancak XZ'nin onları çalma sırasında dönüştürmesi gerekir. Bu, deck başına bir işlemci çekirdeğinin yaklaşık üçte birini kullanır ve stem'lerin hazır olması daha uzun sürer. Dört deck çalarken stem'ler, parça çaldığından daha yavaş hazırlanır.

manual:20c2c0d610472848b864.source: PREV Tap MAKE ACTIVE Open CONNECT › DJ PROFILE . Push CREATE ON THIS XZ , or NEW PROFILE if the USB already has one. Type your DJ name on the on-screen keyboard, then push NEXT: LOGO . Pick a PNG or JPEG image from the USB, or NO LOGO . Images in your own DJPROFILE folder are listed first. Then push NEXT: TAGLINE . Type a few words, such as your genre, city or crew, and push NEXT: REVIEW . To leave the tagline out, push SKIP TAGLINE . Check the review, then push SAVE TO USB 1 or SAVE TO USB 2 . A new profile becomes the active profile on the USB you save it to. Only the DJPROFILE folder on that USB is written. Your music, playlists and stems are not touched. Step Controls Name and tagline The keyboard, SHIFT for capitals, #+= for symbols ( ABC goes back), SPACE , DELETE , BACK to the step before Logo One row per image on the USB, PREV and NEXT for more, RESCAN (or CHECK USB AGAIN ), NO LOGO , KEEP CURRENT when you edit Review CHANGE NAME , CHANGE LOGO , CHANGE TAGLINE , then SAVE TO USB 1 or SAVE TO USB 2 A name holds up to 64 characters and a tagline up to 80. With NO LOGO , your initial is shown on the accent colour. Logos are shown square over black. Nothing is saved until you push SAVE. The bottom line says NOTHING IS SAVED UNTIL YOU PRESS SAVE on the review step.
manual:20c2c0d610472848b864.text: PREV MAKE ACTIVE'e dokunun CONNECT › DJ PROFILE'ı açın . CREATE ON THIS XZ'ye veya USB'de zaten bir profil varsa NEW PROFILE'a basın. DJ adınızı ekran klavyesine yazın, sonra NEXT: LOGO'ya basın . USB'den bir PNG veya JPEG resim seçin ya da NO LOGO . Kendi DJPROFILE klasörünüzdeki resimler önce listelenir. Sonra NEXT: TAGLINE'a basın . Türünüz, şehriniz veya ekibiniz gibi birkaç kelime yazın ve NEXT: REVIEW'a basın . Slogan eklemek istemiyorsanız SKIP TAGLINE'a basın . Özeti kontrol edin, sonra SAVE TO USB 1 veya SAVE TO USB 2'ye basın . Yeni profil, kaydettiğiniz USB'de etkin profil olur. O USB'de yalnızca DJPROFILE klasörüne yazılır. Müziğinize, çalma listelerinize ve stem'lerinize dokunulmaz. Adım Kontroller Ad ve slogan Klavye, büyük harf için SHIFT , semboller için #+= ( ABC geri döner), SPACE , DELETE , önceki adıma BACK Logo USB'deki her resim için bir satır, daha fazlası için PREV ve NEXT , RESCAN (veya CHECK USB AGAIN ), NO LOGO , düzenlerken KEEP CURRENT Özet CHANGE NAME , CHANGE LOGO , CHANGE TAGLINE , sonra SAVE TO USB 1 veya SAVE TO USB 2 Ad en fazla 64, slogan en fazla 80 karakter alır. NO LOGO ile baş harfiniz vurgu rengi üzerinde gösterilir. Logolar siyah üzerinde kare gösterilir. SAVE'e basana kadar hiçbir şey kaydedilmez. Özet adımında alt satır NOTHING IS SAVED UNTIL YOU PRESS SAVE der.

manual:5cced1da3c9c850e24cc.source: on the top bar. Open it to see deck 3 and 4 audio render times and active key shifters across all four decks. P99 is the time at or below which 99% of the last 256 rendered blocks finished; MAX is the longest. Short blocks are scaled to a full block. D3+D4 MAX adds both maxima and compares them with the 5,805 microseconds available per block. New shifts use a stricter 3,483 microsecond budget, leaving time for other work. These render numbers include decoding, time stretch and key shift; they do not measure the complete output path. Use them when you suspect the player is working hard, for example with stems on both decks and four decks running.
manual:5cced1da3c9c850e24cc.text: üst çubuğunda. Deck 3 ve 4 ses dönüştürme zamanlarını ve tüm dört deck boyunca aktif anahtar değiştirici görmek için açın. P99 son 256 dönüştürme bloklarının %99'unun tamamlandığı veya aşağıdaki zamandır; MAX en uzun. Kısa bloklar tam bir blok için ölçeklenir. D3+D4 MAX hem maksimum eklediğini hem de blok başına mevcut 5,805 mikrosekonda karşılaştırır. Yeni değişiklikler, diğer iş için zaman bırakırken daha sıkı bir bütçe kullanır. Bu dönüştürme sayısı dekodlama, zaman uzantısı ve anahtar değiştirme içerir; tam çıkış yolu ölçmezler. Oyuncu, örneğin, her iki deck'lerde hem de dört deck'lerde çalıştığı stem'lerle çalıştığından şüphelenirken kullanın.

desktop:d5db97f97fc727f8fe10.source: SYNC 1 to SYNC 4: SYNC is on and follows that deck. BPM 1 to BPM 4: only the tempo follows, because QUANTIZE is off, a track has no beat grid, a loop is running, or the beat position is not available. LIMIT: the master tempo is out of reach, so the deck keeps its last tempo. EXT MASTER: a LINK player is master, which decks 3 and 4 cannot follow. NO BPM: analyse the track in your DJ software.
desktop:d5db97f97fc727f8fe10.text: SYNC 1 to SYNC 4: SYNC on ve o deck takip eder. BPM 1 to BPM 4: sadece tempo takip eder, çünkü QUANTIZE kapalı, bir pistin vurma ağı yok, bir yuva çalışıyor veya vurma pozisyonu mevcut değildir. LIMIT: master tempo erişimi dışarıda, bu yüzden deck son tempo tutar. EXT MASTER: bir LINK oyuncu ustadır, hangi deck'ler 3 ve 4 takip edemiyor. NO BPM: DJ yazılımında izleme pist.

manual:086e326b6e5d41258b81.source: PREV , NEXT > Step through the profiles on both USBs. 2 OF 3 shows where you are EDIT Change this profile's name, logo or tagline MAKE ACTIVE Makes this the active profile on its USB. Only the USB is written NEW PROFILE Makes another profile on the USB, for an alias or a back to back set CHECK USB Reads both USB ports again ACTIVE ON THIS USB This profile is the one its USB says is playing SHOWN TO THE VJ NOW This is the profile VJ software sees right now FROM ITS FOLDER IN DJPROFILE A profile made from a folder and a logo OLDER CARD: EDIT IT IN VJ.TOOLS An older profile card. Edit it in VJ.Tools, or make a new profile Your active profile also sits in the MODS header, with its logo and name. Tap it, or highlight it and push, to switch between the profiles on both USBs. Note The player's own saved settings are MY SETTINGS in UTILITY. They are separate from your DJ profile.
manual:086e326b6e5d41258b81.text: PREV , NEXT > Her iki USBs adresindeki profillere adım atın. 2 OF 3 nerede olduğunuzu gösterir EDIT Bu profilin adını, logosu veya etiketini değiştir MAKE ACTIVE Bu USB üzerinde aktif profil yapar. Sadece USB yazılmıştır NEW PROFILE USB üzerinde başka bir profil yapar, bir alias veya bir geri set için CHECK USB Her iki USB portları tekrar okur ACTIVE ON THIS USB Bu profil USB diyor oynuyor SHOWN TO THE VJ NOW Bu profil VJ yazılımı şu anda görüyor FROM ITS FOLDER IN DJPROFILE Bir klasörden yapılmış profil OLDER CARD: EDIT IT IN VJ.TOOLS Bir eski profil kartı. VJ.Tools'de düzenleyin veya yeni bir profil oluşturun Aktif profiliniz aynı zamanda logosu ve adıyla MODS başlıkta yer alır. Dokunun veya kilitleyin ve USBs'teki profiller arasında geçiş yapmak için basın. Not Oyuncu'nun kendi kaydedilen ayarları MY SETTINGS içinde UTILITY'dir. DJ profilinizden ayrılır.

manual:44747ca2968b85ca6fd6.source: Four decks adds two software players, DECK 3 and DECK 4, to the XDJ-XZ's own DECK 1 and DECK 2. You hear them on mixer channels CH3 and CH4. A short USB cable from the back of the player to a top USB port carries their sound into the mixer: it leaves through a top USB port and comes back in at the rear USB socket, where a computer with DJ software would connect. The physical controls switch between decks with the same presses DJ software uses on the XDJ-XZ.
manual:44747ca2968b85ca6fd6.text: Dört deck iki yazılım oyuncu, DECK 3 ve DECK 4 eklenir XDJ-XZ'in kendi DECK 1 ve DECK 2. Bunları karıştırıcı kanallarında CH3 ve CH4 duyarsınız. Oyuncu arkadan üst USB portuna kadar kısa USB kablo, karıştırıcıya sesini taşıyar: üst USB port üzerinden ayrılır ve DJ yazılımı olan bir bilgisayar bağlayacak olan arka USB soketine geri gelir. Aynı baskı ile deck'ler arasında fiziksel kontroller XDJ-XZ'da kullanılır.

manual:4925f473ece7eec20df8.source: The bottom channels always follow the mixer, left to right: CH3, CH1, CH2, CH4. Mixer order puts the lanes in the same order, top to bottom. Decks 3 and 4 have a black number on white, as on the jog displays.

Her şerit ve her kanal, deck'inin numarasını bir rozette taşır; böylece hangi deck'in hangisi olduğunu her zaman anlarsınız. Deck 1 ve 2'de gri üzerinde beyaz numara vardır. Deck 3 ve 4'te, jog ekranlarındaki gibi beyaz üzerinde siyah numara vardır.

manual:62a43847aca915aa72a9.source: Turn the side while the deck plays to bend its speed. The faster you turn, the more it bends, so a gentle nudge moves it only a little. manual:62a43847aca915aa72a9.text: Deck hızını eğmek için oynarken yanını çevirin. Ne kadar hızlı döndüğünüzde, o kadar çok eğilir, bu yüzden yumuşak bir çelişki sadece biraz hareket eder. VINYL ile, plaka üstünde çarpın. Bir arka dönmek için plaka çevirin ve gitmesine izin verin: deck durana kadar plaka takip eder, sonra oynar.

manual:66f696237305f7717178.source: The large key in each deck's column is the key the deck plays right now. Tempo with MASTER TEMPO off, a key shift and KEY SYNC all move it. Its colour compares it with the master deck's key. Green means it mixes with the master's key: the same key, its relative major or minor, or one step away on the key wheel, tuned within 25 cents of the master. Amber means it would mix, but it is detuned by more than 25 cents. White means neither, and the master deck itself is always white. Turn KEY MATCH COLOURS off in
manual:66f696237305f7717178.text: Her deck sütununun büyük anahtar, deck'in şu anda oynadığı anahtardır. MASTER TEMPO kapalı, bir anahtar değişikliği ve KEY SYNC hepsi hareket eder. Renkli onu ana deck anahtarı ile karşılaştırır. Yeşil, ustanın anahtarıyla karıştırır: aynı anahtarın, nispeten büyük veya küçük, ya da ustanın 25 sentin içinde düzeltildi anahtar tekerleğinden bir adım uzakta. Amber karıştırmak anlamına gelir, ancak 25 sentin üzerinde ayrılır. Beyaz anlamına gelir ve master deck kendisi her zaman beyaz. KEY MATCH COLOURS kapatın

manual:680cff455983ca6918b4.source: The left column has one tag per lane. The tag of a deck a side controls is pale blue with LEFT or RIGHT. Decks 1 and 2 show the analysed key, the playing key and its cents. Decks 3 and 4 show their playing key and its cents the same way, TRACK KEY until they report it, or NOT CONNECTED and SEE THE CARD while they are not running.
manual:680cff455983ca6918b4.text: Sol sütunda bir etiket vardır. Bir deck etiketinin yan kontrolü LEFT veya RIGHT ile parlak mavi. Deck'ler 1 ve 2 analizli anahtarı, oynanır anahtarını ve senelerini gösterir. Deck'ler 3 ve 4 aynı şekilde oynanır, TRACK KEY rapor edene kadar veya NOT CONNECTED ve SEE THE CARD çalıştırmadıklarında.

manual:d91121cf06de2856d073.source: When you load a track with prepared stems on deck 1 or 2, the player copies the whole track's stems into its memory. While the track plays, its stems no longer read the USB, so mute, solo, beat jumps and loops act at once. The track itself loads in a few seconds, as it does with stems off. With 44.1 kHz stems, the stems are ready about 15 seconds after the load with two decks playing, and about 20 seconds with four. Until then the stem buttons say so (see
manual:d91121cf06de2856d073.text: Stem'leri hazırlanmış bir parçayı deck 1 veya 2'ye yüklediğinizde, oynatıcı tüm parçanın stem'lerini belleğine kopyalar. Parça çalarken stem'ler artık USB'den okumaz; bu yüzden mute, solo, beat atlamaları ve döngüler anında etki eder. Parçanın kendisi, stem'ler kapalıyken olduğu gibi birkaç saniyede yüklenir. 44,1 kHz stem'lerle, iki deck çalarken yüklemeden yaklaşık 15 saniye, dört deck'le yaklaşık 20 saniye sonra hazır olurlar. manual:dcc7cfcae27bf623ed16.source: While the player records, the diary writes nothing to the stick in USB 2, where the recording goes. Each stick holds at most 4 MiB of diary files. Older segments are replaced first, and the previous session's latest segment is kept when a new session starts. Writing pauses during track loads, RAM copies and heavy USB reads. No diary is created on a read-only stick or when less than 64 MiB of free space plus a small write reserve remains. Read-only test sessions save nothing. Normal USB-loader sessions write diary entries when these conditions allow it. Long busy periods and removal can leave gaps.
manual:dcc7cfcae27bf623ed16.text: Oynatıcı kayıt yaparken günlük, kaydın gittiği USB 2'deki belleğe hiçbir şey yazmaz. Her bir çubuk, en fazla 4 MiB günlük dosyaları tutar. Eski segmentler önce değiştirilir ve önceki oturumun son segmentinin yeni bir oturum başladığı zaman saklanır. İzleme yükler, RAM kopya ve ağır USB okuma sırasında yazma durur. Sadece okuma için bir çubuk veya 64 MiB'den az boş alan artı küçük bir yazma rezervine kalırken hiçbir günlüğün oluşturulmaz. Sadece okuyan test oturumları hiçbir şey saklar. Normal USB yükleyici oturumları bu koşullar izin verirken günlük girişleri yazar. Uzun meşgul dönemler ve kaldırma boşlukları bırakabilir.

manual:158491ccbdf08c51113b.source: If a download is interrupted or fails verification, the app makes up to three attempts. Each attempt starts again and must pass the same size and checksum checks. If it still fails, the error distinguishes an incomplete download from a checksum mismatch. Check your connection and try again. If it continues, include that error when reporting the problem.
manual:158491ccbdf08c51113b.text: Якщо завантаження перервалося або не пройшло перевірку, застосунок робить до трьох спроб. Кожна спроба починається спочатку й має пройти ті самі перевірки розміру та контрольної суми. Якщо й далі не вдається, помилка розрізняє неповне завантаження й невідповідність контрольної суми. Перевірте з'єднання й спробуйте ще раз. Якщо це повторюється, додайте цю помилку, коли повідомлятимете про проблему.

manual:128e0d464559fce231fb.source: In OverCue Desktop's Settings, choose the 44.1 kHz FLAC stems option. The XZ plays at 44.1 kHz, so it copies these stems straight into memory. A track's stems are ready sooner, the player does less work while it plays, and the stems take less space on the USB.
manual:128e0d464559fce231fb.text: У Налаштуваннях OverCue Desktop виберіть варіант стемів FLAC 44.1 kHz. XZ відтворює звук із частотою 44.1 kHz, тож копіює ці стеми прямо в пам'ять. Стеми треку готові раніше, плеєр менше працює під час відтворення, а стеми займають менше місця на USB.

provenance.reason: Authored for the OverCue Desktop 44.1 kHz FLAC stems guidance (0.5.1-Beta.3). Replaces Small100 output that changed the meaning, garbled headings or used the wrong word for stems. Native-speaker review remains open.

manual:3e0dc792b8c0b7aaefe2.source: OverCue's default is 96 kHz. These stems still play, but the XZ has to convert them while it plays. That takes about a third of one processor core per deck, and they take longer to become ready. With four decks playing, they become ready more slowly than the track plays.
manual:3e0dc792b8c0b7aaefe2.text: За замовчуванням OverCue використовує 96 kHz. Такі стеми теж відтворюються, але XZ має перетворювати їх під час відтворення. Це займає приблизно третину одного ядра процесора на кожну деку, і стеми довше готуються. Коли грають чотири деки, стеми готуються повільніше, ніж відтворюється трек.

manual:20c2c0d610472848b864.source: PREV Tap MAKE ACTIVE Open CONNECT › DJ PROFILE . Push CREATE ON THIS XZ , or NEW PROFILE if the USB already has one. Type your DJ name on the on-screen keyboard, then push NEXT: LOGO . Pick a PNG or JPEG image from the USB, or NO LOGO . Images in your own DJPROFILE folder are listed first. Then push NEXT: TAGLINE . Type a few words, such as your genre, city or crew, and push NEXT: REVIEW . To leave the tagline out, push SKIP TAGLINE . Check the review, then push SAVE TO USB 1 or SAVE TO USB 2 . A new profile becomes the active profile on the USB you save it to. Only the DJPROFILE folder on that USB is written. Your music, playlists and stems are not touched. Step Controls Name and tagline The keyboard, SHIFT for capitals, #+= for symbols ( ABC goes back), SPACE , DELETE , BACK to the step before Logo One row per image on the USB, PREV and NEXT for more, RESCAN (or CHECK USB AGAIN ), NO LOGO , KEEP CURRENT when you edit Review CHANGE NAME , CHANGE LOGO , CHANGE TAGLINE , then SAVE TO USB 1 or SAVE TO USB 2 A name holds up to 64 characters and a tagline up to 80. With NO LOGO , your initial is shown on the accent colour. Logos are shown square over black. Nothing is saved until you push SAVE. The bottom line says NOTHING IS SAVED UNTIL YOU PRESS SAVE on the review step.
manual:20c2c0d610472848b864.text: PREV Торкніться MAKE ACTIVE Відкрийте CONNECT › DJ PROFILE . Натисніть CREATE ON THIS XZ або NEW PROFILE, якщо на USB вже є профіль. Введіть своє DJ-ім’я на екранній клавіатурі, потім натисніть NEXT: LOGO . Виберіть зображення PNG або JPEG з USB або NO LOGO . Зображення з вашої папки DJPROFILE показано першими. Потім натисніть NEXT: TAGLINE . Введіть кілька слів, наприклад жанр, місто чи команду, і натисніть NEXT: REVIEW . Щоб обійтися без гасла, натисніть SKIP TAGLINE . Перевірте огляд, потім натисніть SAVE TO USB 1 або SAVE TO USB 2 . Новий профіль стає активним профілем на USB, куди ви його зберегли. Записується лише папка DJPROFILE на цьому USB. Ваша музика, плейлисти й стеми не змінюються. Крок Керування Ім’я та гасло Клавіатура, SHIFT для великих літер, #+= для символів ( ABC повертає), SPACE , DELETE , BACK до попереднього кроку Логотип Один рядок на зображення на USB, PREV і NEXT, щоб побачити більше, RESCAN (або CHECK USB AGAIN ), NO LOGO , KEEP CURRENT під час редагування Огляд CHANGE NAME , CHANGE LOGO , CHANGE TAGLINE , потім SAVE TO USB 1 або SAVE TO USB 2 Ім’я вміщує до 64 символів, гасло — до 80. З NO LOGO ваша початкова літера показується на кольорі акценту. Логотипи показуються квадратом на чорному. Нічого не зберігається, доки ви не натиснете SAVE. На кроці огляду нижній рядок показує NOTHING IS SAVED UNTIL YOU PRESS SAVE.

manual:309bd86e6dfe608aa6a6.source: In the pad mode you choose for stems, four pads switch stems on that deck. A, B and C mute the three stems in your STEM ORDER. D is BYPASS: it plays the original track instead of the stems. On a 4-stem track, D mutes bass instead. With the E-H bank, E to H do the same.
manual:309bd86e6dfe608aa6a6.text: У режимі падів, який ви вибрали для стемів, чотири пади перемикають стеми на цьому деці. A, B і C вимикають три стеми у вашому STEM ORDER. D — це BYPASS: він грає оригінальний трек замість стемів. На треку з 4 стемами D натомість вимикає бас. З банком E-H те саме роблять пади E–H.

manual:5cced1da3c9c850e24cc.source: on the top bar. Open it to see deck 3 and 4 audio render times and active key shifters across all four decks. P99 is the time at or below which 99% of the last 256 rendered blocks finished; MAX is the longest. Short blocks are scaled to a full block. D3+D4 MAX adds both maxima and compares them with the 5,805 microseconds available per block. New shifts use a stricter 3,483 microsecond budget, leaving time for other work. These render numbers include decoding, time stretch and key shift; they do not measure the complete output path. Use them when you suspect the player is working hard, for example with stems on both decks and four decks running.
manual:5cced1da3c9c850e24cc.text: на верхній панелі. Відкрийте його, щоб побачити деку 3 і 4 аудіопрограмування часи і активні ключові перекилки по всіх чотирьох дек. P99 - час, коли 99% останніх 256 відправлених блоків закінчено; MAX - це найдовший. Короткі блоки масштабуються до повного блоку. D3+D4 MAX додає як максимуму і порівнює їх з 5,805 мікросекунди доступні на блок. Нові перекиди використовують більш суворий бюджет 3,483 мікросекнди, залишаючи час для іншої роботи. Ці числа рендера включають декодинг, розтягування часу і перекину ключа; вони не вимірюють повний шлях виходу. Використовуйте їх, коли ви підозрюєте, що гравець працює важко, наприклад, з стеми на обох деках і чотирьох робочих дек.

manual:8c4a0bf0fd4a0b3a95de.source: The XZ Mods app runs on your computer. It puts XZ Mods on a USB, makes stems for your tracks, makes your DJ profile, keeps the app and your USB up to date, holds tools for your library, games and the XZ screen, and sends your reports and ideas to the maintainer. It never formats a drive and never changes your music or the library your DJ software exported.
manual:8c4a0bf0fd4a0b3a95de.text: Додаток XZ Mods працює на вашому комп'ютері. Він ставить XZ Mods на USB, робить стеми для ваших треків, робить ваш профіль DJ, зберігає додаток і USB дозвіл на вашу бібліотеку, ігри та екран XZ, а також надсилає ваші звіти та ідеї до обслуговування. Він ніколи не форматує диск і ніколи не змінює вашу музику або бібліотеку, експортується програмне забезпечення DJ.

manual:aae7a2de86d1b8fe2f33.source: Stems makes vocal, harmonic and drum stems for the tracks on your music USB and writes them beside each track. Plug in the USB your DJ software exports your music to. The app lists every track on it. Your tracks and the library your DJ software exported stay as they are.
manual:aae7a2de86d1b8fe2f33.text: Стеми роблять вокальні, гармонічні і барабанні стеми для треків на вашій музиці USB і пише їх поруч з кожним треком. Включити в USB ваш програмне забезпечення DJ експортує вашу музику. Додаток перераховує кожну треку на ньому. Ваші треки і бібліотека ваш програмне програмне забезпечення дидже експортується залишатися такими, як вони є.

desktop:d5db97f97fc727f8fe10.source: SYNC 1 to SYNC 4: SYNC is on and follows that deck. BPM 1 to BPM 4: only the tempo follows, because QUANTIZE is off, a track has no beat grid, a loop is running, or the beat position is not available. LIMIT: the master tempo is out of reach, so the deck keeps its last tempo. EXT MASTER: a LINK player is master, which decks 3 and 4 cannot follow. NO BPM: analyse the track in your DJ software.
desktop:d5db97f97fc727f8fe10.text: SYNC 1 до SYNC 4: SYNC надійде і йде за цим декою. BPM 1 до BPM 4: тільки темпо слідує, тому що QUANTIZE відключено, трек не має бит-сети, руп працює, або позиція удару не доступна. LIMIT: майстер темпо не досягається, тому дека зберігає свій останній темп. EXT MASTER: LINK Player - майстер, який деки 3 і 4 не можуть слідувати. NO BPM: аналіз треку в програмному програмі DJ.
